jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Brand Manager

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Role overview 🌟

Alan has passed 1M members, works with 40K+ companies and operates in seven countries. New products and a flagship international event are coming, and the Brand team is investing in bigger campaigns. So far brand spend has gone mostly to broad awareness. We now need targeted B2B campaigns for specific verticals (for example TNS, retirees, very small company owners), run alongside the broad campaigns to reinforce them.

You'll own these vertical B2B brand campaigns for France, plus a portfolio of other brand projects. You'll work closely with the Brand Lead, Product Marketing, Growth, segment owners and Sales. This is an individual-contributor role at C1-D level.

What you'll do

  • Vertical campaigns: Define the audience, message, proof points and channels for each priority vertical. Choose priorities and objectives with segment owners, Growth and Product Marketing. Run each campaign from brief to post-mortem, and build reusable toolkits (messaging, assets, case studies) for other teams.

  • Product and offer launches: Support the launch of new product features (e.g. Mo, Alan Précision) and new offers (e.g. Alan retirees) in France. Work in strong collaboration with the Product teams to build a creative, impactful go-to-market that stands out in the market. Turn product positioning into launch plans and assets.

  • Partnerships and events: Run vertical-specific events, sponsorships, ambassador and creator partnerships that build credibility with each audience.

  • Local markets: Give feedback on local briefs and plans. Spot French initiatives that could scale to other markets and capture them in playbooks.

  • Measurement: Set KPIs for every project (reach in the target, qualified leads, pipeline influenced, brand perception). Run test-and-learn with Growth and Data. Manage budgets, vendors and deadlines.

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years of in-house brand marketing (B2C, B2B or B2B2C). Paid media or media planning is a big plus.

  • Have led at least two B2B campaigns or brand projects end to end, and can walk us through the problem, your choices and the measurable result.

  • Have managed agencies and budgets and made trade-offs when resources were tight.

  • Are a generalist across campaigns, content, partnerships, events and PR, with sharp creative judgment you can defend with senior stakeholders.

  • Set brand KPIs and link brand work to pipeline or lead quality.

  • Work well with Sales and Growth and can influence without authority.

  • Written and verbal communication fluency in English and French

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced and strategic Global Marketing Manager to join our team in London on a 12-month fixed-term contract to cover parental leave. In this role, you’ll act as a key connector between our US-based marketing organization and our international team. You’ll help localize and scale Progyny’s marketing efforts globally, support go-to-market initiatives, and play a meaningful role in driving our growth outside the US.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of global strategy and local execution.

Tasks

  • Support product marketing initiatives, including messaging and positioning for new product launches across international markets.

  • Strong ability to collaborate across functions and geographies

  • Strong project management skills with a high level of ownership and attention to detail

  • Hands-on, execution-focused mindset

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits

  • 💰 Competitive salary: Annual gross base salary range: From GBP 72,000 – 80,000 (based on experience)

  • 🍼 Access to the Progyny Global platform + GBP 5,000 family-building benefit

  • 🚲 Mobility allowance

  • 💪 Gym allowance

  • ✈️ Up to 8 weeks remote work from anywhere

  • 🌈 Inclusive, mission-driven culture built on care, collaboration, and innovation

We believe that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. If you’re passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering world-class care, and shaping the future of global member experience, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
jobs.description:
Senior People Ops Manager (International)

About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.description:
Copy of Senior Manager, Maintenance –Compounding Pharmacy Facilites

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

This role reports to the Site Lead. The Senior Manager, Maintenance leads the maintenance and reliability function for a GMP peptide manufacturing facility, providing high-level support to the Site Operations and Engineering organization through predictive and preventive maintenance programs for all production, utility, and facility equipment. This position analyzes, troubleshoots, and communicates maintenance problems and concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air and process gases, HVAC, and clean utilities, as they relate to equipment and controlled environments in the facility. The Senior Manager works with general supervision and will interact with the Site Lead regularly to receive guidance and feedback. Many non-routine activities will require the Site Lead’s advance approval.

You Will:

  • Lead a group of maintenance technicians, supervisors, and managers across a multi-shift, multi-discipline operation.

  • Own the predictive and preventive maintenance program for all GMP equipment, including peptide synthesizers, preparative HPLC and purification systems, lyophilizers, filtration and TFF skids, reactors, isolators and hoods, autoclaves, and associated controls.

  • Maintain and reliably operate facility and clean utilities, including HVAC and cleanroom environmental systems, purified water/WFI, clean steam, compressed air, nitrogen and other process gases, and chilled and hot water systems.

  • Document maintenance, technical, and other data on predictive/preventive maintenance charts, as required.

  • Diagnose and repair equipment and systems throughout the facility, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air, PLC/controls, and HVAC repairs.

  • Identify facility and equipment issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take remedial action using a predictive maintenance approach.

  • Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks, product quality impact, or loss to Hims or its associates.

  • Work as directed in all areas of the facility to maintain safety and health standards.

  • Perform and oversee calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards.

  • Conduct regular checks and measurements to verify equipment performance, including temperature, pressure, speed, and other relevant parameters.

  • Maintain calibration records and documentation in compliance with cGMP and other regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure that all equipment meets regulatory and quality standards and take corrective actions to address any non-compliance issues.

  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs to implement and maintain proper documentation, including equipment logs, maintenance records, change controls, deviations/CAPAs, and qualification and validation reports.

  • Support equipment and facility qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), commissioning, and requalification activities, and maintain the validated state of equipment through the change control process.

  • Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimize downtime.

  • Work closely with production personnel to coordinate repairs and planned maintenance and minimize disruptions to the manufacturing schedule.

  • Develop and manage the maintenance budget, spare parts strategy, and external contractor and vendor relationships.

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, efficiency improvements, and cost savings related to equipment maintenance and operation.

  • Participate in cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and contribute to a continuous improvement culture within the organization.

  • Stay updated with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices related to pharmaceutical and peptide manufacturing equipment maintenance.

  • Make sure all assets, parts, and work orders are updated and tracked in CMMS for all facility equipment.

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Maintenance, or a related technical field; equivalent technical training/certification may be considered.

  • 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing or another highly regulated environment.

  • 10+ years of people leadership experience, including leading hourly and salaried technical teams.

  • Strong working knowledge of cGMP requirements and maintaining equipment in a GMP environment.

  • Hands-on expertise troubleshooting and maintaining advanced mechanical, electrical, and automated equipment, including PLC and CMMS systems.

  • Experience leading preventive and predictive maintenance programs, interpreting technical data, and driving equipment reliability and continuous-improvement initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and assess technical talent; delegate complex work; and build effective shift and staffing structures.

  • Experience partnering across multiple facilities or teams to implement scalable maintenance systems and solve network-level operational challenges.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations to senior leaders.

  • Ability to meet the physical requirements of the role, including lifting up to 50 pounds, working at heights, climbing ladders/stairs, and operating safely in an industrial environment.

  • Availability to support urgent operational needs outside regular business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, API, peptide, or other GMP manufacturing environments.

  • Technical certification or formal training in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, compressed air, or PLC systems.

  • Advanced degree or training in engineering, maintenance, Lean, Six Sigma, or a related discipline.

  • Spanish language skills.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Engineer
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

Are you a self-driven engineer who thrives on the shop floor? We are looking for a pragmatic, structured, and hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Production and Maintenance Team in the heart of Zurich.

In this role, you work in the value stream, taking responsibility for our daily manufacturing operations. You provide first-level support and diagnose technical issues to maintain throughput and testing uptime. Your scope includes the maintenance of our current robot generation and driving the NPI execution on the shop floor, specifically the build and troubleshooting of prototypes and zero-series units.

You act as the interface between Industrialisation, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, and Logistics, while collaborating with our EMS partner to ensure stable series production. If you have an "on-hands" mentality and want to implement KPIs to resolve bottlenecks in a high-tech scale-up, this is your next challenge.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Railways, Wind Energy, Mining, Construction). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the technology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.


Your Impact
  • Provide first-level technical support to ensure efficient production flow and minimize downtime
  • Document Non-Conformities (NCRs), perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions
  • Take ownership of the maintenance, calibration, and improvement of production tooling and test equipment
  • Monitor First Pass Yield (FPY) and throughput times consistently to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks
  • Lead projects and initiatives to optimize output, efficiency, and on-time delivery
  • Drive the optimization of the end-to-end value stream for pilot series production and maintenance operations
  • Execute New Product Introduction (NPI) and the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on the shop floor
  • Ensure test procedures and work instructions are technically accurate and up to date

    • Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma (HF/FH) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics
  • 3 years+ experience in a high-tech manufacturing or robotics environment
  • Strong troubleshooting ability with a self-driven proactive and structured mindset
  • Experience with test instruments, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and power supplies
  • Proven hands-on skills in soldering, crimping, and cable assembly
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
  • Excellent technical communication and presentation skills
  • Fluency in German and English (Level B2 minimum)

    • Bonus Points
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience with test data analysis or yield monitoring tools
  • Familiarity with firmware update and validation workflows
  • Driving license CH-Cat. B
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

Your Qualifications

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

jobs.description:
Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

  • Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung – bei uns und beim Kunden. Erfahrene Kolleg:innen begleiten dich, bis du dich in der Systemlandschaft und den Fachbereichen sicher bewegst.

  • Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen wie Sales, Controlling oder Marketing nimmst du Anforderungen auf und setzt sie in Kennzahlen, Datenmodelle und Berichte um.

  • Du begleitest Vorhaben von der Anforderung über Test und Produktivsetzung bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.

  • Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und das Windhoff-Projektteam, schätzt Aufwände, stimmst Prioritäten mit Fachbereichen, Kunden-IT und weiteren Dienstleistern ab und unterstützt bei Presales- und Angebotsprozessen.

  • Du gestaltest die Modernisierung bestehender Landschaften mit, etwa die Überführung von Berichten nach Microsoft Power BI oder erste Machine-Learning-Anwendungen, und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the People team

Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.

Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.

You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..

What you'll be doing

  • Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side.

  • Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

  • Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves.

  • Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort.

  • Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person.

  • Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project.

  • Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you.

  • Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for.

  • Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend.

  • Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role.

  • Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information.

  • Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Compensation

This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off and learn more about your background.

  2. Manager interview with our People Lead to explore your experience in more depth.

  3. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team.

  4. Values interview to get to know how you work and how that aligns with hx's culture with our VP of People and Senior Director of Finance and Operations.

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Check out our blog at Insights & Blog - hyperexponential

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

The Opportunity
 

As a Senior Industrialization Engineer, you will own the transition of our advanced robotic systems from R&D into scalable, high-quality production. Right now, this means spearheading Design for Excellence (DFX) initiatives and ensuring our next-generation quadruped robots are optimized for manufacturing and assembly. You'll work in close collaboration with our Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production teams to bridge the gap between complex engineering concepts and robust manufacturing realities.

 
 
The Market & Our Technology
 
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. We build quadruped robots designed to perform autonomous inspections in the world's most challenging industrial environments, from offshore energy platforms to complex chemical plants. Moving beyond prototyping, our hardware must meet rigorous standards for reliability, ingress protection, and durability while remaining feasible for efficient, scalable assembly.

Your Impact
  • Own and lead the Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) strategy across new hardware programs
  • Collaborate closely with R&D during the early design phases to embed Design for Excellence (DFX) principles into every mechanical component
  • Optimize complex mechanical designs for manufacturability without compromising the robot's performance or ruggedness in harsh environments
  • Drive continuous improvement in production processes by identifying design bottlenecks and engineering scalable solutions

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

At ANYbotics, we build autonomous, end-to-end robotic solutions that automate routine industrial inspections in complex and hazardous environments. As an Industrialization / Electronics Test Engineer, you will play a central, high-impact role within our Operations team in Zurich, directly enabling the production scaling of our advanced legged robots.

By taking ownership of our electronics production test systems, you will bridge the gap between R&D, manufacturing, quality, and external supply partners. You won't just be sitting behind a desk designing isolated components—you will solve challenging real-world problems, build scalable test infrastructure, and directly shape our manufacturing capabilities as ANYbotics continues to expand globally.

The Market & Our Technology

Industrial facilities present some of the world's most severe operating conditions. Our flagship autonomous platforms, ANYmal and ANYmal X, are designed to navigate multi-story plants, stairs, and hazardous areas—delivering continuous operational insight without human risk. Scaling the manufacturing of these highly sophisticated quadrupedal robots requires robust, state-of-the-art electronics testing setups and a relentless commitment to hardware reliability and product yield.


Your Impact

  • Own and continuously improve existing and next-generation electronics production test systems for ANYmal products

  • Develop and deploy functional, In-Circuit Testing (ICT), and end-of-line test solutions for complex PCBAs and electronic assemblies

  • Drive root-cause analysis on production failures and test data to boost manufacturing quality and yield

  • Support the industrialization and rollout of ANYmal X and future robotic platforms

  • Introduce best practices for scalable testing, automation, lifecycle management, and hardware maintenance

  • Serve as the main technical interface between Operations, R&D, Quality, and EMS manufacturing partners

  • Proven experience in electronics test engineering within a production or hardware manufacturing environment

  • Strong hardware debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills

  • Practical familiarity with standard test equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, and programmable power supplies

  • solid understanding of hardware communication protocols including CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, and Ethernet

  • Hands-on experience with test automation and scripting languages like Python or LabVIEW

  • Proactive, hands-on mindset with a strong drive to collaborate directly with physical hardware and cross-functional teams

Senior IT Engineer

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

jobs.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Power Electronics Engineer

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: System Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description:
System Engineer (Control Systems)

System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

Senior Product Manager (Towed Array Solutions)

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 

As Senior Product Manager Towed Array Solutions you join our towed array product group as its second Product Manager, as we expand the team to keep pace with our current growth. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support.

You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

  • Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems.

  • Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software.

  • Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team.

  • Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness.

  • Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering.

  • Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution.

  • Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS.

  • In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience with sonar, towed arrays or underwater acoustics, ideally in ASW or ISR applications, is a big plus.

  • Experience with naval surface vessel programs, ideally submarine or special warfare support missions.

  • Experience with defense procurement, naval platform integration and export-controlled products.

  • Experience with fiber optic sensing technology.

  • Proficiency in tooling such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, BigPicture, JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, Miro and PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

About Osano:

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role:

Reporting to Executive leadership, the Sr. Manager of IT & Operations owns Osano's internal technology environment day to day. This role runs IT operations, manages the corporate technology stack, and improves systems, security, and employee experience over time. The ideal candidate is hands-on, operationally excellent, and ready to take on more strategic ownership as the company grows.

Core Responsibilities

Operations and Systems Ownership:

  • Own and continuously improve Osano's internal IT operations, including endpoint management, identity and access, SaaS administration, and corporate infrastructure.
  • Keep systems reliable and employees productive.

IT Roadmap Execution:

Budget and Vendor Management:

Security and Compliance:

Technical Scope

Automation and Lifecycle Management:

jobs.description:
Sr. Manager, Data Science

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As the Senior Manager, Data Science leading our UK team, you will be one of the earliest members of Hims & Hers' data science function in the UK, joining as we stand up the team alongside the company's new technology hub there. You will help shape how the UK team works and grows from this early stage, without a long-established structure to inherit.

You are equal parts technical leader and people leader: you set the roadmap for what your UK team builds and in what order, unblock technical decisions when the path forward is unclear, and develop your reports into stronger technical leaders themselves.

You will report to the Director of Data Science (based in the US) and operate as one team with our US-based data scientists, not a separate satellite. That means real day-to-day collaboration across the Atlantic: shared standards, a shared roadmap, and enough overlap in working hours to pair on hard problems. You will work closely with the Director to figure out how to best organize a team split across two countries, from how work gets divided to how the team is structured, so that it delivers the most impact to the business rather than just replicating a US structure overseas. You will partner directly with Finance, Marketing, and Operations leadership to translate business priorities into a team roadmap, then make sure that roadmap actually ships.

You Will:

  • Help Establish the UK Team: As one of the earliest members of the UK team, help shape the working norms, technical culture, and onboarding experience for the data scientists who join after you.

  • Lead as One Distributed Team: Operate the UK team as a single function with the US-based data science org, not a separate silo, keeping standards, context, and priorities consistent across the time zone gap.

  • Shape the Roadmap: Partner with the Director of Data Science and the US team to prioritize competing requests from Marketing, Operations, Product, and Finance into a shared roadmap, and help make the tradeoff calls for what the UK team builds and when.

  • Stay Technically Close: Review designs and code at a level of depth that lets you catch bad technical decisions early, even though you are not the one writing production code day to day.

  • Unblock Ambiguity: Step into the highest-ambiguity problems on the team's roadmap when your team needs a second set of hands or a tie-breaking technical call.

  • Set the Technical Bar: Establish and enforce the standards (code review, documentation, model monitoring, experimentation rigor) your team builds against, consistent with the US team and in partnership with Staff-level ICs.

  • Own Delivery: Take accountability for whether your team's 0-to-1 builds actually ship, work reliably in production, and deliver the business outcome they were built for.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, including 2+ years directly managing data scientists or ML engineers.

  • Early-Stage Team Experience: Track record of joining or helping shape a brand-new team, office, or region from an early stage, rather than only working within an established structure.

  • Distributed/International Collaboration: Experience working on or leading a team split across countries or significant time zones, comfortable with the communication overhead and async workflows that requires.

  • Proven People Leadership: Track record of developing and retaining data science talent, including calibrating performance and managing through periods of team growth.

  • Technical Credibility: Strong enough in Python, SQL, and applied ML (regression/classification, time-series, causal methods) to review your team's technical decisions and unblock them, even without writing production code daily.

  • Prioritization Under Constraint: Demonstrated ability to help sequence a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands with limited headcount, and to make a clear, well-reasoned case for tradeoffs even when the final call is shared with others.

  • Executive Communication: Comfortable translating technical work into a narrative for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders, and negotiating scope and timeline with them directly.

  • Engineering Rigor: Familiarity with production ML systems (cloud environments, CI/CD, ML Ops) sufficient to hold your team to a real production bar, not just notebook-quality work.

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent experience. We weigh hands-on empirical research experience, such as a thesis or lab-based program, over the specific field of study.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • US/UK Collaboration, Specifically: Direct experience working across a US/UK (or similar transatlantic) split team, ideally within a company still establishing its presence in one of those regions.

  • Advanced Business ML (experience leading or reviewing work in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) models used to drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

    • Applied Forecasting: time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or demand/revenue planning under limited historical data.
