jobs.title: Technical Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Marketing Manager

As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams, as well as memory design and strategic partnership teams, you gather validated information to create key materials, including product and specification documents in line with system architects and product managers, datasheets, reference manuals, whitepapers, application notes, technical blogs, and technical presentation decks.

In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences. 

Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market.

Technical writing/content development  |  primary focus

  • Write technical documentation (product, specifications..), customer-facing datasheets, reference manuals.

  • Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content.

  • Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering.

  • Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations.

  • Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders.

  • Create and coordinate high-quality technical content: website copy, product pages, whitepapers, presentations, and conference materials

Interface with Product, Architecture & Engineering

  • Work closely with the Product/Architecture team and relevant engineering experts to gather information about functionality, use cases, performance, power, bandwidth, integration and system-level trade-offs.

  • Ask probing technical questions, distinguish demonstrated results from targets, and turn source material into precise, readable drafts.

  • Coordinate technical review and approval with the relevant subject-matter owners and marketing lead before external release; maintain the traceability and versioning of technical claims.

Technical marketing & enablement

  • Participate in first-level customer technical meetings to present and support technical specifications, architecture choices, and performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs to system architects.

  • Support early customer engagements with tailored messaging and technical storytelling

  • Produce technically sound product and competitive comparisons that support the positioning and priorities defined by the Marketing Lead.

  • Develop technical content for product pages, demonstrations, customer briefings, partner presentations and Business Development enablement.

  • Support agreed conference submissions and product milestones with the technical material needed by speakers and customer-facing teams.

  • Support presence at industry events, conferences, and partner demos

Content execution & quality

  • Own timelines, drafts, review loops, version control and delivery for assigned content; flag missing inputs and risks early.

  • Maintain a curated, approved repository of technical facts, diagrams, reusable explanations and reference materials.

  • Demonstrate adaptability to a fast-moving startup environment and evolving targets.


Training background :  Degree in electronics, microelectronics, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience is also welcome.

Relevant experience:   Practical experience in technical writing, technical marketing, applications engineering, product engineering, or another engineering-facing communication role. Suitable seniority may range from an emerging independent contributor to an experienced specialist.

Technical / industry knowledge:  Solid understanding of semiconductor hardware and system concepts; familiarity with memory architectures, SoCs, AI accelerators, advanced packaging or compute infrastructure is strongly valued. Ability to understand performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs and data from technical experts is essential.

Writing / communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate effectively in meetings, structure detailed technical arguments, edit precisely, and tailor content to technical audiences. Evidence of authored documentation or published technical content is a strong plus.

Design & Visual Content Independence: Must be capable of creating compelling technical content, diagrams, and visual assets independently (e.g. Powerpoint, Google slides, Canva, Gimp..) without relying on external agencies, and should be well-versed with office productivity tools and presentation software.

Interpersonal skills and ways of working:  Curious, rigorous, comfortable challenging ambiguous input; proactive in working with engineers; strong prioritization, commitment to deadlines and careful technical-review discipline.


Other considerations:  Portfolio or writing samples preferred. You should be able to write strong first drafts independently, while keeping in mind that final product definitions and external claims are handled by the product and marketing leads.

Generative AI Tools: Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflows to enhance content creation productivity and efficiency.

jobs.title: Digital Account Manager - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Digital Account Manager - Netherlands

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members!

We are looking for a Digital Account Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise, outstanding client communication, and an AI-first mindset.

This is a highly client-facing role: you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey.

You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations.

The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively, turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI, to work smarter, faster and with better insights.

Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

  • Client Communication & Relationship Management
    • Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps
    • Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations
    • Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies
  • Campaign Set-up & Coordination
    • Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary
    • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time
  • Optimization & Performance
    • Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client
    • Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams
  • Reports, Presentations & Sales Support
    • Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations
    • Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals
  • AI-Powered Ways of Working
    • Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow
    • Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation
  • Collaboration & Administration
    • Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration
    • Handle client invoicing

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

  • Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment.
  • Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships.
  • AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter.
  • Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once.
  • Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must.
  • Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance.
  • Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English.
  • Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE 🎆

  • Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion).

LOCATION 🌐

While you need to be based in the Netherlands, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

jobs.title: Mobile Developer
jobs.description:
Mobile Developer

At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. As a Mobile Developer, you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working.

Your role

As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain.

You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI.

  • Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment.

  • You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications.

  • You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines.

  • You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)

Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support our recruiting team as we scale the organization. In this 6-month contract, you’ll be owning interview logistics, keeping candidates informed, and helping us deliver a best-in-class candidate experience across technical and non-technical roles.

This is a great opportunity for someone with coordination experience who wants to deepen their recruiting skills in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

Contract Details

  • Duration: 6 months with possibility to extend

  • Schedule: 40 hr. work week

  • Location: ideally based in San Francisco, CA or New York City, NY

What You’ll Learn

  • You will learn how to run end-to-end recruiting coordination for a high-growth startup & across multiple teams.

  • You will get experience partnering with recruiters and hiring managers across multiple functions.

  • You will learn foundational sourcing skills, including building top-of-funnel pipelines and using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter and Covey.

  • You will observe how to track and analyze core recruiting metrics (pipeline health, conversion rates, time-to-hire).

  • You will develop best practices for maintaining clean ATS data and creating simple reports/dashboards.

  • You will be able to deliver a best-in-class candidate experience through clear communication and strong logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Assist recruitment team by coordinating and scheduling interviews throughout all stages of the interview process, ensuring a positive and professional interaction for potential hires.

  • Assist with additional scheduling of internal team meetings, candidate debriefs, and others as needed.

  • Act as the ATS administrator in Ashby handling all system management, own LinkedIn admin and other recruiting tools, and oversee all Notion database management and maintenance.

  • Package a weekly Recruiting progress report for the Executive leadership team.

  • Partner cross-functionally to identify areas for improvement within recruitment activities to continuously improve process.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, answering questions, providing timely updates, and setting clear expectations to deliver a warm, professional, first-class experience with Phantom.

  • Help maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in our ATS.

  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements and keep interview processes moving smoothly.

  • Proactively flag bottlenecks and help unblock processes so candidates move efficiently through the funnel.

  • Support occasional recruiting events.

Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of coordination experience (e.g. recruiting coordination, office coordination, executive assistant, operations, or similar role with heavy scheduling/logistics).

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent).

  • Preference to work out of our San Francisco or NY office at least 2 days per week if local to those areas.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable juggling multiple requests and changing priorities.

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates and internal stakeholders.

  • Comfort working with tools like Google Workspace & Notion.

  • Must be highly organized, efficient and process driven.

  • Excellent at anticipating needs and creating structure out of ambiguity.

  • Exceptional critical thinker who can tackle complex problems, is quick to respond and has a high attention to detail with little to no error.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth tech company.

  • Hands-on experience with an ATS such as Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby.

  • Prior exposure to technical recruiting (engineering, product, data) or university recruiting.

  • Genuine curiosity about crypto, blockchains, or web3 products.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Senior E-Commerce / D2C Manager (m/w/d)

Über Patronus

Patronus hilft Menschen, Schädlinge im eigenen Zuhause selbst loszuwerden: von Silberfischen über Lebensmittelmotten bis zu Ameisen und Mardern. Mit wirksamen Produkten, klaren Anleitungen und Beratung, die ernst nimmt, wie unangenehm so ein Befall ist.

Seit 2020 verkaufen wir direkt an unsere Kundinnen und Kunden: über unseren eigenen Online-Shop patronus-shop.de, über den TikTok Shop und über Amazon. Unser Team arbeitet remote aus Deutschland, Georgien, Indonesien und Pakistan. KI ist bei uns kein Zukunftsthema, sondern Alltag: Wir bauen unsere Auswertungen, Automatisierungen und viele interne Werkzeuge selbst mit KI.

Die Rolle

Bisher hat einer unserer Gründer den Online-Shop selbst gesteuert. Diese Verantwortung übergeben wir jetzt an dich, und zwar vollständig. Du verantwortest das Wachstum und die Profitabilität unseres D2C-Geschäfts, führst ein Team aus sieben Menschen, steuerst unsere Agenturen und entscheidest selbst über Budgets, Aktionen und Prioritäten. Ohne lange Freigabeschleifen, in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise mit eigener Verantwortung für Umsatz oder Ergebnis

  • Sicheren Umgang mit Performance-Marketing und Kennzahlen: Du weißt, was ein Kunde kosten darf, und rechnest das auch nach

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams, gern remote und über Ländergrenzen hinweg

  • Ein Gespür für Texte, die verkaufen, und für Creatives, die funktionieren

  • Spürbare Begeisterung für KI und die Bereitschaft, deine Arbeitsweise damit grundlegend zu verändern

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift und fließendes Englisch (ein Teil des Teams arbeitet auf Englisch)

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Advertorials, Native Ads und Direct-Response-Marketing

  • Kenntnisse in WooCommerce/WordPress, Google Analytics 4 und Google Tag Manager

  • Erfahrung mit Klaviyo, TikTok Shop oder A/B-Testing-Programmen

  • Grundverständnis von Werberecht, idealerweise im Bereich regulierter Produkte

Deine Aufgaben

Wachstum & Profitabilität

  • Du findest Wachstumsmöglichkeiten im Shop und in neuen Kanälen und bringst sie konsequent auf die Straße.

  • Du verantwortest den Deckungsbeitrag des D2C-Geschäfts: Werbekosten, Preise, Bundles, Rabattaktionen und Margen.

  • Du planst die wöchentlichen Aktionen und das Sortiment im Shop entlang der Schädlingssaison.

Team & Agenturen

  • Du führst sieben Direct Reports: zwei Menschen im Videoschnitt, eine Person im Grafik- und UX-Design, je eine in der Web- und der App-Entwicklung, eine im Kundenservice und eine im CRM.

  • Du steuerst unsere Agenturen, aktuell fürGoogle Ads und TikTok, setzt Ziele und hinterfragst Ergebnisse.

  • Du sorgst für klare Prioritäten, verbindliche Taktung und gute Briefings, damit das Teamschnell und selbstständig arbeiten kann.

Conversion & Shop

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte für Produktseiten, Upsell-Seiten nach dem Kauf und Landingpages, inklusive Feedbackschleifen mit Design und Entwicklung.

  • Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie sauber aus und setzt um, was gewinnt.

  • Du verantwortest die Qualität unserer Produktseiten: Inhalte, Produktdaten,Vergleiche und die vorgeschriebenen Produktangaben.

Creatives & Content

  • Du schreibst Skripte und Briefings für Video-Ads, Reels und statische Creatives und gibst sie in Produktion.

  • Du recherchierst je Schädling, was Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich bewegt, und leitest daraus Botschaften, Hooks und Verkaufsargumente ab.

  • Du verantwortest Blog, SEO und weitere Inhalte, die für den Shop arbeiten.

CRM & Kundenbindung

  • Du steuerst E-Mail-Marketing, Kundenbindung und unser Treueprogramm, um Wiederkäufe und Kundenwert zu steigern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Kundenservice zusammen und machst aus Kundenfeedback Verbesserungen im Shop.

Daten & KI

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis sauberer Zahlen: Tracking, Attribution und unser eigenes Dashboard sind dein Werkzeug.

  • Du setzt KI gezielt ein, um Prozesse zu verbessern, neu aufzubauen und zu dokumentieren, und baust bei Bedarf eigene Werkzeuge mit KI.

Woran du gemessen wirst

  • Deckungsbeitrag des D2C-Geschäfts nach Werbekosten

  • Profitabilität auf den Erstkauf und Kosten jeNeukunde (CAC)

  • Conversion Rate und Warenkorbwert

  • Wiederkaufsrate und Kundenwert

  • Tempo und Verlässlichkeit deines Teams

Damit arbeitest du bei uns

Du musst nicht alles schon kennen. Wichtig ist, dass du dich schnell einarbeitest und Lust hast, neue Werkzeuge auszuprobieren.

  • Shop & Warenwirtschaft: WooCommerce/WordPress, JTL-Wawi, TikTokShop

  • Werbung: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads

  • Daten & Tracking: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Metorik, eigenes Tracking-Dashboard

  • CRM & Service: Klaviyo, Freshdesk

  • Zusammenarbeit & Design: Notion, Figma, WhatsApp

  • KI: Claude, Obsidian als gemeinsames Firmenwissen, Higgsfield / ElevenLabs für Bild und Video

Und wenn ein Werkzeug fehlt, baust du es dir mit KI selbst. So sind bei uns unter anderem unser Tracking-Dashboard und viele Automatisierungen entstanden.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Echte Verantwortung
    Du entscheidest selbst über Budgets, Agenturen und Aktionen

  • KI ohne Grenzen
    Alle KI-Werkzeuge, die du brauchst, zahlen wir

  • Schlanke Strukturen
    Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Innovatives, internationales Team
    das bereits KI-gestützt arbeitet

  • Remote-Arbeit
    mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Workation im EU-Ausland nach Absprache

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Hardware nach Wahl

  • Weiterbildungsbudget
    für Konferenzen, Kurse und Communities

  • Treffen vor Ort
    mit den Gründern, nach Wunsch und Abstimmung

Vergütung

Für diese Position liegt das Gehalt bei EUR 70,000–85,000 pro Jahr + erfolgsbezogenem Bonus bis 20.00€ zusätzlich

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Beispiele deiner Arbeit: ein Test, eine Kampagne oder ein Projekt, das du selbst verantwortet hast, mit ein, zwei Sätzen zu deiner Rolle und dem Ergebnis. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Erzähl uns stattdessen kurz, wie du KI heute in deiner Arbeit einsetzt.
Schritt 1: Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch
Schritt 2: Praxisnahe Fallaufgabe aus unserem Shop
Schritt 3: Abschließendes Gespräch mit den Gründern

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Embedded Systems Engineer The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms.

In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. Your work will enable silicon bring-up, hardware validation, remote access, observability, and platform automation for our validation platforms and production systems.

You will work across hardware and software domains, collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, validation, firmware, and system teams to ensure our in-house accelerator silicon can be brought up, debugged, validated, and accessed efficiently.

This is a hands-on role combining embedded development, hardware integration, laboratory debugging, and technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards.

· Evaluate, select, and integrate MCUs, management controllers, sensors, and supporting hardware components.

· Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation.

· Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks.

· Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams.

· Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements.

· Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity.

· Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities.

· Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.

· Support manufacturing test, firmware provisioning, and lifecycle management processes.

· Drive technical execution across multiple projects while contributing to architecture, risk reduction, and long-term platform strategy.

· Generate design documentation, validation procedures, and engineering guidelines.

Minimum Qualifications:

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

· 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware and software.

· Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ development.

· Solid understanding of digital hardware design and board-level electronics.

· Experience reading and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and hardware interface specifications.

· Familiarity with I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART, GPIO, JTAG, and other common embedded interfaces.

· Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment.

· Experience with Linux-based development environments.

· Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualificacions:

· Experience with OpenBMC, embedded Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar platforms.

· Experience developing board management controllers, service processors, or platform management solutions.

· Experience supporting silicon bring-up, board bring-up, or hardware validation programs.

· Familiarity with data center, server, networking, accelerator, or HPC hardware.

· Understanding of power sequencing, PMBus, telemetry, monitoring, and voltage margining concepts.

· Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and other high-speed platform interfaces.

· Experience developing automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.

· Exposure to manufacturing test, production provisioning, and deployment workflows.

· Knowledge of secure boot, firmware update mechanisms, and remote-management architectures.

Soft skills:

· A systems-level mindset spanning both hardware and software.

· Strong technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges.

· The ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines.

· Sound engineering judgment and a pragmatic approach to problem solving.

· Ownership and accountability for delivering robust platform management solutions that enable successful silicon bring-up and platform validation.

What We Offer?

· A chance to work at one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe with cutting-edge technology and industry leaders

· We offer a remuneration package that values your experience

· We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development

· Join an innovative team and experience company growth

· Travel within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia, to work with our teams and partners

We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you identify with Openchip, please contact us.

At Openchip, we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Foundations

Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do.

What you'll build and own

  • Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on.

  • Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction.

  • Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows.

  • Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness.

  • Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services.

  • Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions.

  • Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras.

Your experience

  • At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment.

  • A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not.

  • Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways.

  • Comfortable with the full lifecycle - design, build, operate, improve - with evidence of genuine end-to-end ownership rather than handing off to other teams.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI development tools in your daily engineering workflow; you validate AI output rather than blindly accepting it.

  • Strong opinions about system design, API contracts and service boundaries, backed by real examples you can walk us through.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to fintech, payments or identity/KYC systems.

  • Experience building SDKs or developer-facing platform services consumed by other engineering teams.

  • Prior work in a high-growth startup or scale-up (roughly 50-500 people) where you had to set standards, not just follow them.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

jobs.description:
Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform

About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

 


What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

    • 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

    • 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

    • 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

    • 5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

    • What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:
  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

    • What You Bring:

    Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

    • Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

    • AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

    • Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

    • Nice to Have:
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.

Senior Legal Counsel - Business

Senior Legal Business Partner / Commercial Counsel – EMEA

Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?

DiliTrust is a global SaaS company dedicated to transforming legal and governance departments through innovative technology. Our integrated suite supports legal teams in managing contracts, entities, board activities, and other critical legal operations more efficiently.

DiliTrust combines a strong international presence with an entrepreneurial culture, helping customers across multiple markets digitize and simplify their legal processes.

Your role

As Senior Legal Business Partner, you will act as a trusted legal advisor to DiliTrust’s commercial organization across Europe and the Middle East. Based in Paris, you will support business growth by leading and negotiating a broad range of commercial agreements, while helping internal stakeholders identify practical and proportionate solutions to legal and business risks.

You will partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Professional Services, Security, Finance, and other business functions. Your role will be both strategic and hands-on: you will manage negotiations directly, improve contracting processes, and help the business close opportunities efficiently while protecting DiliTrust’s interests.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of commercial agreements for DiliTrust.
  • Advise Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Professional Services, Finance, and other stakeholders throughout the contract lifecycle.

jobs.title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. 

  • Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. 

  • Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. 

  • Apply Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration-as-code practices so Apple platform changes are controlled, repeatable and auditable. 

    • Security, Compliance & Observability 

  • Translate macOS security and compliance requirements into Jamf configuration profiles, automated controls and measurable outcomes. 

  • Automate macOS and third-party application patching, vulnerability remediation and exception handling. 

  • Build guardrails for FileVault, endpoint protection, authentication, privacy controls and device compliance. 

  • Create inventory, telemetry, dashboards and alerting that provide actionable visibility into automation performance, Mac health and risk. 

  • Partner with Security teams to automate evidence collection, audit reporting and remediation workflows for the Apple estate. 

    • Engineering, Lifecycle & Support 

  • Define the macOS and Jamf automation architecture, engineering standards and roadmap for a global Apple device service. 

  • Engineer automated packaging, deployment, update and rollback pipelines for macOS applications. 

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service. 

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services. 

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention. 

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively. 

    •  
     

    What you'll need

  • Jamf 300 certification. 

  • 4+ years of experience engineering and automating macOS services in a modern enterprise environment. 

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, smart groups, extension attributes, inventory, application deployment and API-based administration. 

  • Strong knowledge of macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, declarative device management and Apple security controls. 

  • Ability to build production-quality automation using shell scripting, Python, REST APIs and structured data formats, supported by Git, CI/CD, testing, secrets management, Jamf webhooks and code review. 

  • Experience automating macOS application packaging, deployment, patching and vulnerability remediation; a bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 

    •  

    Additional experience that would be valuable: 

  • Experience with identity integrations, Platform SSO, certificate services, zero-touch deployment and device trust. 

  • Knowledge of Installomator, swiftDialog, Nudge, or similar community and enterprise macOS automation tooling. 

  • Experience integrating Jamf with ServiceNow, asset-management, security, observability or data platforms. 

  • Cloud services, serverless functions, SQL or reporting technologies used to host integrations and analyse endpoint data. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Linux or mobile device management in a broader endpoint environment. 

    •  
     

     


     

    What we offer

    A competitive compensation package, of course.  

    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 


    Meet your team

    We’re Employee IT. We’re on a mission to deliver a seamless user experience for TomTom'ers across. Whether we're creating solutions to enable collaboration, increase productivity or help people communicate, your work will ensure TomTom'ers are equipped to create the first real-time map. In our team, you’ll help design, develop, deliver, operate and support solutions through a defined set of services, so that we can continue to bring people closer to the world around them.

jobs.title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
jobs.description:
Product Manager Insurance P&C

Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter.

At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe. No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer.

We are a high-growth European scale-up, backed by €43M from world-class investors, on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here.

At our core, we’re a tech company. We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair.

We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do.


What you'll be doing:

Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio. This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance.

Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.


What you’ll be up to (some examples):
  • Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.
  • Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.
  • Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.
  • Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.
    • This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

    Specifically, you bring:
  • 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.
  • Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.
  • Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).
  • Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

    • Who this is not for:
  • You prioritize a 40-hour work week: We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week.
  • You prefer your comfort zone: We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here.
  • You prefer to stay high-level: While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit.
  • A steep learning curve feels daunting: We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months.

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.
  • In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam.
  • Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy.
  • Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team.
  • Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe.

    • Our culture (read this carefully)

    We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader. That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace.

    Our culture is defined by three things:

  • High ownership
    People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it.
  • High pace
    Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection.
  • High standards
     Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through.

    • At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone.

    We believe great work happens through close collaboration. We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface.

    This is a human-sized company. You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset.

    We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here.

    If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now

  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Due to our continued growth we are seeking a Regulatory and Site Start Up Specialist.

The Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (RSS) is an experienced professional in regulatory and site start-up activities. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the location of the RSS and include but are not limited to initial and subsequent clinical trial submission to Competent Authorities and IRB/ Ethics Committees, Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Essential Document collection and quality review, supporting sites on IRB/EC submissions and provide support to the Site Contract Management group in budget and contract negotiation. The RSS may act as Subject Matter Expert for questions by other in-country members (CRAs, CSSs or others) supporting site start-up activities and may contribute to development or revision of country specific tools and guidance documents to ensure compliance with local and international clinical trials regulations and guidelines.

Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Customer Operations

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

About our Machine Learning Operations team:

The challenges are significant: we aim to transform customer service by reducing the time and effort required to resolve issues, enhancing customer confidence and satisfaction. As part of Operations, you’ll be at the forefront of our mission to provide unparalleled customer support experiences.

Your role will be pivotal in leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning techniques (including LLMs and autonomous agents) to understand customer problems. You will lead the development of an effective human-in-the-loop system that augments automation with the efforts of our support workforce (who we call COps). This allows us to more expediently and efficiently predict, identify, disambiguate, and route customer problems at scale to support a rapidly expanding company with global ambitions across multiple geographies.

You’ll be working closely with a team of Machine Learning Scientists in Operations, embedded in product squads alongside data scientists, backend, mobile and web engineers, product managers, user researchers, designers, and operations specialists.

Your day-to-day:

As a technical individual contributor, you’ll be providing technical leadership and shipping highly impactful ML-based solutions. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional product squad, working closely with product managers, data scientists, backend engineers, and designers in an agile environment. You’ll also be a technical leader within the wider Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.

This will involve:

  • Working with stakeholders across the organisation to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to transform Customer Operations with Machine Learning.

  • Leading the design and development of advanced Machine Learning models, exploring how LLMs, RAG, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in query resolution and routing.

  • Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.

  • Steering ongoing technical strategy, working closely with our MLOps team and backend engineers to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company

  • You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact
