jobs.title: Copywriter
jobs.description:
Copywriter

Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Phantom is building the global trading app for mass adoption. We’re hiring a mid-level Copywriter in our Brand Innovation Group who can turn complex ideas into language people get instantly, while also shaping a brand voice that feels native to Gen-Z and the wider culture we’re trying to build.

You’ll split your time between innovative brand campaigns, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing. You’ll also bring ideas and projects to life that actually matter in culture: spotting what’s resonating on social (especially TikTok), reading taste, and turning those signals into work that extends Phantom beyond pure product messaging.

Responsibilities

Ideas, Culture and Social

  • Have a refined pulse on social media, especially TikTok, and the broader cultural currents that shape Gen-Z taste, humor, and attention.

  • Bring big-picture thinking to the table: identify cultural moments, trends, or community behaviors worth engaging with, and propose concrete ways Phantom can show up.

  • Develop, champion, and help deploy ideas and projects that build culture around the brand, not just promote features. This could include stunts, community campaigns, content series, or other formats that go beyond standard marketing.

Product Marketing

  • Write copy for social and website that supports launches and feature releases, with language that feels clear, specific, and culturally current.

  • Partner with product marketing managers to turn positioning into sharp, audience-native writing.

  • Draft in-app copy (feature announcements, empty states, onboarding moments) in close collaboration with design and product.

  • Help keep Phantom’s tone of voice consistent and distinctive across every surface, using brand guidelines as the foundation while pushing them forward where culture demands it.

Growth Marketing

  • Write lifecycle copy for email, push, and in-app messaging that moves people from signup through activation and ongoing engagement.

  • Write paid acquisition ad copy and generate variations for testing, with a feel for what actually resonates with Gen-Z and mass audiences.

  • Work with growth marketers on test hypotheses, then use results to decide what to scale, revise, or kill.

  • Adapt copy to audience segment, channel constraints, and market while keeping the brand’s cultural point of view intact.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years as a copywriter or in a similar creative role, with a portfolio that shows strong digital and brand writing and evidence of strategic or idea-led work that has cultural reach.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills: clarity, tone, voice, and the ability to make complex things feel simple and human.

  • Genuine fluency in Gen-Z language, platforms, and culture. You know what feels native versus what feels forced.

  • Comfort thinking in bigger ideas and turning them into executable projects, plus a track record of (or clear desire for) work that builds culture and reflects real taste, not just executing briefs or campaigns.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You can explain product value and also shape how people feel about the brand.

  • Experience collaborating across functions, including with technical or product teams, and influencing without formal authority.

  • Understanding of marketing principles, digital tactics, and how to use performance data to improve work

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)

01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Behind every megawatt hour our customers save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies, together around 2% of Europe's energy demand, make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works like a digital colleague. The colleagues we need most are the ones we haven't found yet.

Finding them is your job. We're about 15 people and growing fast, with open roles in engineering, value engineering and the public sector. There is no recruiting playbook yet and no HR department. You'll write the playbook and decide who RIZM becomes.

02 · Meet Diana, your teammate

Hi, I'm Diana. I run recruiting at RIZM today, 20 hours a week next to my studies, together with Lorenz, our Founders Associate. We've built the first funnel, but there are more good people out there than two part-time recruiters can reach. That's why we need you: someone who owns hiring full-time and takes it further than we can. You'll have Josh, our co-founder, as your sparring partner for offers and tricky decisions. Questions before you apply? Message me on LinkedIn.

Diana

03 · What you'll do

  • Own hiring end to end: From the first message to the signed offer, for every open role at RIZM.

  • Build the system: Design our process, stations, scorecards and tools from scratch, and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board.

  • Find the right people: Source engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

  • Win people over: Run first conversations, tell our story well and make every candidate feel looked after, even when the answer is no.

  • Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI, and always know where the funnel gets stuck.

  • Get us seen: Careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

04 · What you bring

  • Experience: A few years in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, including technical profiles.

  • People sense: You spot potential that isn't on the CV and talk to engineers as equals.

  • AI-native: You try new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster.

  • Builder drive: You'd rather create structures than step into them, independently, reliably and fast.

  • Ownership: You care about results, not activity, and you're motivated by being paid for them.

  • Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

05 · Why you should apply now

You're the first full-time recruiter. What you build stays.

  • Pay that follows your impact: A fixed salary plus uncapped variable pay and equity. Every hire you make shows up directly in what you earn.

  • Direct line to the founders: Hiring is their top priority.

  • A network that moves you forward: Sparring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird.

  • Once a year, we get out: A team offsite with inspiring guests.

  • Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership.

06 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest lines on these two questions.

  1. What's the best hire you ever made or helped make, and how did you find that person?

  2. Write the first message you'd send to a senior engineer who isn't looking for a new job. Five lines at most.

After that:

  • Intro call: 15 minutes on video with Diana to get to know each other.

  • Case study: A short, practical recruiting case you work on at home.

  • Case presentation: 30 minutes online with Lorenz and Diana.

  • Meet the founders: At our office. Then we decide together.

Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)

As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

 
 

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description:
Control & Estimation Intern

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams.

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Prediction Markets)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager (Prediction Markets)

Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

Prediction markets are one of Phantom's top priorities, and the category is still wide open. The interfaces everyone uses today are not the end state. As a Senior Product Manager on the Predictions team, you'll shape what trading on real-world events should feel like, from five-minute crypto markets to live sports, politics, and culture.

You'll start with something most prediction products spend years building: more than 20 million people who already hold and trade their money in Phantom, tokens, perps, and stablecoins in the same app. We're looking for someone with the creativity to use that, the judgment to decide what matters, and the drive to see it through without waiting to be asked.

Responsibilities

  • Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading predictions simpler and more connected.

  • Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.

  • Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.

  • Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works.

  • Make every trade trustworthy. Own trade execution, position and PnL accuracy, and clear market resolution, so traders can rely on every number on the screen.

  • Own market discovery and retention. Decide which markets we list and feature, how we surface live events, and how personalization, notifications, and social features give traders reasons to return.

  • Make the calls. Decide what to build, what to cut, and when something is ready to ship, often with incomplete information, and own the outcome.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and our exchange and liquidity partners to ship in a regulated category. Set shared goals and report progress every week, including what isn't working.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a full-time Product Manager or founder, including a consumer product you owned end to end and grew through measurable improvements in adoption, retention, or revenue.

  • You trade yourself (prediction markets, perps, crypto, or something more exotic) and have strong opinions about which products do it well. Comfortable reasoning about order books, liquidity, pricing, and settlement.

  • Original product thinking, with a record of turning what you learned from users into something new that people adopted.

  • Strong design sensibility. You can point to work where you made something simpler without taking power away from the people who wanted it.

  • You stay close to users and use AI agents and data to test what you hear, investigate product performance, and measure whether your decisions worked.

  • You pick up problems without being asked and see them through. You know when to gather more evidence and when to make a call.

  • A close collaborator. You can lead engineering, design, legal, and marketing without formal authority, and you're technical enough to work through exchange, onchain, and data integrations in detail.

  • Bonus points if you have:

    • Worked at a prediction market, sportsbook, exchange, or brokerage.

    • Built something on crypto rails that could not have been built without them.

    • Built real-time, live-event, or high-frequency trading products.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

jobs.description:
Performance Marketing Manager

About Osano

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role

Osano is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own and optimize our digital marketing programs, drive qualified pipeline, and maximize the return on our marketing investments.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and analytics. You'll take ownership of our paid media programs, from campaign development and audience targeting to budget management, experimentation, and performance optimization.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just understand performance marketing in theory but has experience getting into the platforms, building campaigns, analyzing results, and making adjustments that drive measurable business outcomes.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and Revenue Operations to ensure our digital marketing investments are reaching the right audiences, generating qualified opportunities, and contributing to revenue growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own and execute Osano's paid media strategy across Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and emerging advertising channels, including YouTube, Reddit, and AI-driven platforms.
  • Manage paid campaigns directly within advertising platforms, including campaign setup, keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop and execute performance marketing programs designed to generate qualified leads, increase conversions, and contribute to sales pipeline and revenue.
  • Monitor and optimize key performance indicators, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and pipeline contribution.
  • Manage paid media budgets, continuously evaluating channel performance and reallocating spend to maximize marketing efficiency and return on investment.
  • Build and execute A/B tests across ad creative, messaging, landing pages, audiences, and conversion paths to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Content to develop compelling advertising messages, creative assets, and landing pages tailored to target audiences.
  • Analyze website traffic, landing page performance, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with Revenue Operations to ensure accurate campaign tracking, lead attribution, CRM integration, and performance reporting.
  • Leverage HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and other marketing tools to measure campaign effectiveness and understand how marketing investments influence pipeline.
  • Develop audience segmentation and retargeting strategies to engage high-value prospects throughout the buyer journey.
  • Support account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives through targeted digital advertising campaigns.
  • Explore emerging advertising channels, AI-powered marketing tools, and automation opportunities to improve campaign execution and performance.
  • Create and maintain performance dashboards that provide clear visibility into campaign results, marketing spend, and pipeline contribution.
  • Share insights and recommendations with Marketing and Sales leadership, translating performance data into actionable business decisions.
  • Stay current on digital advertising trends, platform changes, and performance marketing best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related field, preferably within B2B SaaS or technology.
  • Demonstrated success managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads, pipeline, and measurable business results.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads is required, including building, launching, managing, and optimizing campaigns directly within the platforms.
  • Experience managing paid media budgets and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign efficiency and ROI.
  • Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, audience targeting, retargeting, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.
  • Experience analyzing performance metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Proficiency with marketing analytics and reporting tools, including Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform reporting.
  • Experience working with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the B2B SaaS buyer journey, lead generation, attribution, and pipeline development.
  • Experience developing and executing A/B tests to improve advertising performance, landing page conversions, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Comfortable managing campaigns independently, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets, and competing priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and experience partnering with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and Content teams.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new advertising channels, emerging technologies, and AI-powered marketing tools.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain campaign performance and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't measured simply by how much advertising we run or how many leads we generate. It's about building an efficient, scalable performance marketing program that consistently turns marketing investments into meaningful business results.

You'll be successful when you're:

  • Generating a consistent flow of qualified leads and pipeline through paid marketing channels.
  • Improving campaign efficiency by reducing acquisition costs and increasing conversion rates.
  • Demonstrating clear ROI and pipeline contribution from marketing investments.
  • Building scalable, repeatable paid media programs that support Osano's growth goals.
  • Using testing, experimentation, and analytics to continuously improve campaign performance.
  • Providing clear visibility into marketing spend, channel effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  • Identifying new opportunities to reach high-value audiences and expand our digital marketing presence.

Who You Are

You're a data-driven marketer who loves turning insights into action. You enjoy digging into campaign performance, identifying opportunities, testing new approaches, and seeing the measurable impact of your work.

You're equally comfortable developing a performance marketing strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You know your way around advertising platforms, understand what drives conversions, and aren't afraid to experiment when something isn't working.

You understand that successful performance marketing isn't about generating the most clicks or leads. It's about reaching the right audiences, creating meaningful engagement, and turning marketing investment into qualified pipeline and revenue.

Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership. You don't need a large team or agency to execute your ideas. You're energized by building, optimizing, collaborating, and finding

Why Us

  • A well-defined career path that’s not just “climbing the ladder” - learn different competencies, skills, and concepts as you progress and get recognized for it.
  • Supportive leadership and peers - from sales engineering and product marketing to sales development and demand generation - you’re never in this alone.
  • You’ll be stepping into a space that’s on fire – the privacy and regulatory landscape is only growing with a ton of opportunity in front of us.
  • You’ll become a privacy expert, including the opportunity to receive your Certified Information Privacy credential.
  • You’ll be representing a product that makes prospects say, “This is so awesome” when you demo it.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation + ownership interest for an early stake in our success!
  • Unlimited paid time off with a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year.
  • We're continuously a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents + believe that family, however you define it, comes first.
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums for base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance via Aetna.
  • A fully, permanently remote company so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook + $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun together!
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness + talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Office Manager

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

As our Office Manager in Munich, you'll have an incredible role as a people driven person who's passionate about the day to day operations and administrative needs of the office, to helping curate a best in class workplace environment and assisting on events.

  • You’ve worked at a startup. You’ve been through the speed and the ambiguity, and the “we’re doubling headcount next quarter” moments. You know how to build processes without slowing anyone down.

  • You care how the office feels. You notice the small things: the coffee, the light, how a new joiner’s first morning goes, whether the meeting rooms actually work. You want people to come in because they’d rather be there.

  • You’re an operator at heart. You’ve managed vendors, facilities, supplies, budgets, health and safety, access and maintenance, and you keep it all running smoothly in the background.

  • You can run events. You’ve planned team socials, all-hands, offsites, investor visits and community nights. You can take one from a rough idea to a polished event, often with little notice.

  • You’re very organised and you follow through. You juggle a dozen moving parts, and nothing gets dropped or waits on someone else to chase it.

  • You’re a great communicator. You build good relationships with everyone, from new engineers to the founders, landlords and suppliers. People find you warm, approachable and dependable.

  • You’re happy owning things alone. You don’t need a playbook. You see what’s needed, set a high bar and get it done.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Security Engineer

About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

In February, we raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make our applications, and the platform they run on, secure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work inside our engineering teams, review how our platforms are designed, find where they are weak, and help get them fixed.

Much of the job is setting up practices we don't yet have. You'll make threat modelling a normal part of how we plan and build, introduce vulnerability management across our applications and AWS infrastructure, and automate security testing at every stage of the delivery pipeline. We want checks that run on every change, so engineers find problems early and fix them in their own teams without everything having to route through you.

We're investing in AI-assisted engineering across the company, and we have a working group exploring where it helps us build better software. Security is part of that work from the start. You'll join the working group, set the guardrails and automated checks that hold every change to the same standard however it was written, and use the same tools in your own work.

Job responsibilities

  • Make threat modelling a standard part of how engineering plans and builds, run it on the highest-risk work, and train teams to do their own

  • Review the security architecture of our platforms end to end, and turn what you find into prioritised work

  • Set up and run vulnerability management across application code and AWS infrastructure, with a clear severity model and agreed fix times

  • Build automated security testing into every stage of the pipeline, covering secrets scanning, static and dynamic testing and dependency checks, tuned so it catches real problems without getting in the way

  • Run internal penetration testing as a continuing activity, using AI tools to test features as they ship, and coordinate external testing

  • Put AWS security guardrails in place as Terraform, and keep configuration from drifting

  • Set up how we manage and rotate secrets, and build controls for our software supply chain

  • Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants, and keep production data out of non-production

  • Build the guardrails for agentic engineering, covering what agents can access, how they are sandboxed, which tools and connectors they can use, and the checks agent-written code has to pass before it merges

  • Give engineers practical security advice day to day, and fix issues yourself when that is the fastest way to get them fixed

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Strong product or application security background built on software engineering experience, and comfortable reading, writing and reviewing code

  • Experience running threat modelling and getting engineering teams to adopt it as their own

  • Experience introducing vulnerability management that engineering teams work to

  • Hands-on with security testing across the pipeline, including secrets scanning, SAST, DAST and SCA, and with tuning those tools to cut noise

  • Experience penetration testing web applications and APIs

  • Good working knowledge of AWS security, including access and identity, networking and encryption, and able to read, review and write Terraform

  • Use AI coding agents in your daily work, and can show security tooling, tests or review checks you've built with them

  • Understand the security risks that agents bring, including prompt injection, over-broad permissions and untrusted dependencies

  • A developer-first outlook, where success looks like engineers choosing the secure option and owning their own security

  • Clear communicator who can turn security risk into practical decisions for technical and non-technical colleagues

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built security guardrails for teams working with coding agents or automated software delivery

  • Worked on software that serves many customers from shared infrastructure, and the data-separation questions that come with it

  • Worked in a functional language such as Haskell, or built security checks for a language the standard tools cover poorly

  • Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry

  • Helped build security practices from an early stage

  • Spent time training and coaching engineers on security

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

jobs.description:
Senior Partner, ER, Policy & Compliance

About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

 

About the Role:

Build and mature Sitecore’s Employee Relations and Investigations practice, creating the operating model, investigation standards, policy framework, governance and practical toolkits needed to drive consistency and confidence across the business. Serve as the subject-matter expert for complex employee relations matters and workplace investigations, partnering with business leaders, People Business Partners and Legal to ensure fair, thorough and risk-conscious outcomes. Use case insights, early intervention, manager enablement and preventative practices to address issues before they escalate, strengthen working relationships and continuously improve the employee experience

 

What You'll Do:

Employee Relations

  • Develop and implement the ER framework covering intake, assessment, investigation, escalation, resolution and follow-up, with clear responsibilities, decision points, guidance and templates for managers/HRBPs

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs to recognise emerging concerns, intervene early; facilitate informal resolution and mediation where appropriate to resolve issues before they escalate

  • Independently manage grievances and workplace concerns; lead or coordinate fair investigations with clear documentation and evidence-based findings

  • Partner with managers and HRBPs on recommendations, decisions and communication, involving Legal and other specialists as appropriate and escalating sensitive or high-risk matters

  • Maintain accurate, confidential records; use case trends to identify recurring issues and preventative action. Build manager and HRBP capability through practical guidance, coaching and training

HR policies

  • Own the policy lifecycle: identify gaps, draft and update policies, and coordinate consultation, approval, communication and review to support business needs, consistent employee experiences and applicable employment requirements

  • Partner with Legal, HRBPs and subject matter experts to balance a consistent company approach with local requirements; maintain a central library with clear ownership, version control and review dates

  • Create accessible guidance, templates and communications for employees and managers, using employee feedback and case experience to improve policy clarity and application

Employment compliance

  • Maintain a compliance tracker with Legal and local HR partners covering requirements, actions, owners and deadlines; coordinate legislation implementation through policy, process, guidance and training updates

  • Review ER processes and policy application, identify gaps, agree corrective actions and track completion. Coordinate policy acknowledgements and relevant mandatory training, maintaining completion records

  • Support employment-related audits and information requests with clear records and track agreed follow-up actions.

 

What you will bring:

  • Substantial relevant ER experience, typically around eight years, or equivalent relevant education and experience; independent management of complex, sensitive cases from assessment through resolution

  • Experience in early intervention, manager coaching, informal resolution, ER process development and drafting, reviewing and implementing HR policies

  • Strong working knowledge of employment legislation in supported jurisdictions, judgement about seeking specialist legal advice, and experience across countries or partnering with local specialists on different employment requirements.

  • Sound judgement in assessing incomplete or conflicting information and making practical recommendations; strong investigation, documentation and communication skills, explaining sensitive issues clearly and influencing stakeholders.

  • Ability to build workable processes while managing an active caseload and competing priorities

  • Experience partnering closely with in-house Legal or external employment counsel

Nice to have:

  • A qualification or background in employment law, legal studies, or employment legislation and regulatory compliance

  • Litigation experience

A relevant HR qualification or professional accreditation

Why Join Sitecore?

At Sitecore, you'll have the opportunity to shape and strengthen how we manage employee relations, support our leaders and create consistent employee experience across a global organization.

This is a highly visible role where you will have the opportunity to influence people practices, build scalable frameworks and partner with stakeholders across the business, making a tangible contribution to both our culture and organizational effectiveness.

 

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore:

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Enablement Lead, Government
jobs.description:
Enablement Lead, Government

About the Team

The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact.

We work alongside public servants to move from initial exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI. Our work combines hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, community, content, and practical transformation tailored to government missions and operating environments.

By translating the potential of OpenAI’s technology into better individual workflows, stronger teams, and improved public services, we help government customers deepen adoption, build lasting organizational capability, and spend more time on mission.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Government is a specialist role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering experiences that support repeatable adoption frameworks, drive sustained activation, expand the breadth and depth of usage, and produce measurable value for government organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, education, adoption, community, content, and customer experience. It blends strong product fluency, instructional design, customer advisory, and a deep understanding of public service. You will lead live workshops, deliver enablement programs, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from front-line public servants and technical practitioners to senior government leaders.

You will be a trusted guide to government customers, helping them learn, share, teach, celebrate successes, and use AI confidently in their day-to-day work. You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective patterns for responsible adoption across government organizations.

  • Lead government customers through the full enablement lifecycle, from initial onboarding and activation through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

  • Define and manage structured enablement and deployment programs with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures of success.

  • Design and deliver high-impact engagements—including onboarding sessions, advanced capability training, executive briefings, academies, hackathons, listening sessions, and hands-on mission or workflow labs—for audiences ranging from senior leaders to front-line staff.

  • Guide government leaders, champions, technical teams, and working teams through organizational change by building confidence, establishing effective habits, and translating product capabilities into practical workflows and mission outcomes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for designated products, roles, or government mission areas, building deep expertise and identifying emerging public-sector use cases for new product capabilities.

  • Develop government-specific learning journeys, training materials, playbooks, FAQs, demonstrations, use cases, customer impact stories, and communications that enable high-quality adoption programs to scale.

  • Provide timely education for product launches, new features, and capability rollouts, translating product updates into clear and practical relevance for government users.

  • Advise government customers on workforce communications and engagement strategies that build awareness, confidence, participation, and sustained use.

  • Build trusted relationships with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, champions, and front-line public servants, creating experiences that reflect an understanding of their constraints, motivations, and responsibilities to the public.

  • Support government customer communities, events, and peer-learning experiences by keeping resources, discussions, updates, and thought leadership useful and current.

  • Identify and amplify government champions, creative use cases, and meaningful customer outcomes that encourage responsible experimentation, recognize public servants’ contributions, and help other organizations learn.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Product, Global Affairs, Communications, Marketing, Readiness, and other teams to deliver cohesive experiences for public-sector customers.

  • Gather and synthesize government customer feedback, adoption signals, participation data, and engagement outcomes to improve enablement programs and bring the voice of public servants back to Product and other internal stakeholders.

  • Identify patterns across government customers and translate them into scalable programs, content, playbooks, and best practices without losing the human connection required to support public servants effectively.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer-facing, enablement, instructional, adoption, or transformation roles, engaging executive, business, and technical audiences in government or similarly complex enterprise environments.

  • Understand and value public service and can build credibility with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, and front-line public servants.

  • Possess exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, particularly when translating complex AI capabilities into clear, accurate, and practical value for audiences with different levels of technical fluency.

  • Have experience designing learning journeys and leading workshops, training programs, executive engagements, customer events, or scaled adoption initiatives.

  • Bring strong practical fluency and enthusiasm across ChatGPT, Agents, and the broader OpenAI product ecosystem, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to real-world government workflows.

  • Are a versatile writer and storyteller who can turn complex information into useful and compelling training materials, presentations, demonstrations, communications, and customer stories.

  • Can connect product capabilities and enablement activities to measurable outcomes such as activation, sustained usage, improved quality, faster delivery, reduced administrative burden, better decision-making, risk reduction, customer satisfaction, or mission impact.

  • Can identify patterns across government customers and convert them into scalable systems, programs, content, and best practices.

  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, adapting in live customer environments, and bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.

  • Bring humility, empathy, curiosity, and a genuine desire to help public servants and colleagues succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and responsible evolution of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
VP of Engineering

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

About Us

ClearBank is a technology‑enabled, fully regulated bank providing cloud‑based banking and payments infrastructure to financial institutions. We operate at scale in a highly regulated environment, where trust, resilience and security are critical.

Our engineering organisation is focused on enabling frequent, reliable change while maintaining strong controls. We believe quality is not a gate at the end of delivery, but something designed in from the very start.

Role Purpose

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the strategy, design, build, operation and ongoing resilience of ClearBank’s payments and cards platforms.

The VP of Payments & Cards will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for real-time, scheme-connected payments and cards systems across the UK, Europe, and future international markets. This requires deep experience working close to the infrastructure that moves money. Ideally, this will include direct integration with major payment schemes or rails, such as FPS, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK, SEPA payment schemes in Europe, or ACH and Fedwire in the US. We will also consider experience gained through payment infrastructure providers or connectivity platforms provided it includes sufficient technical depth in payment processing, scheme connectivity and the operation of highly available, regulated payments infrastructure. The role will define platform strategy, engineering standards, tooling and ways of working, while embedding a shift-left quality mindset across delivery. Success means delivering highly resilient, highly available, secure, scalable and compliant platforms that enable frequent, reliable change in a regulated banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, design, build and run of real-time payments and cards platforms across the UK, Europe, the US and future international markets, including direct scheme connectivity and integrations with third-party payment infrastructure providers.

  • Lead the delivery and operation of digital wallet capabilities, including Apple Pay and Google Pay implementations.

  • Set the technical direction for payments and cards platforms, ensuring architectural choices support resilience, availability, scalability, performance, security and cost efficiency.

  • Own the budget for the Payments and Cards engineering teams, ensuring effective investment in people, tooling and platforms.

  • Build, lead and develop high-performing engineering teams, creating clear accountability, strong delivery discipline and a culture of engineering excellence.

  • Ensure platforms are designed and operated to meet the following outcomes:

  • Highly resilient — supporting local and cross-region disaster recovery requirements.

  • Highly available — targeting 99.999% aggregate internal availability where appropriate.

  • Highly scalable — supporting aggressive growth targets and future business volumes.

  • Performant — meeting scheme performance requirements and exceeding client expectations on latency.

  • Cost optimised — balancing client value, operational efficiency and ClearBank’s cost base.

  • Establish scalable engineering quality standards, practices and governance across the payments and cards domain.

  • Embed quality, observability, operational readiness and control requirements into delivery practices and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive engineering productivity through AI-assisted and increasingly agentic software engineering, including the effective use of AI coding tools and multi-agent approaches across development, testing and engineering workflows, with appropriate risk, security and regulatory guardrails.

  • Partner closely with the CTO, engineering leaders, product, risk, compliance and operations teams to ensure delivery decisions balance pace, quality and control.

  • Ensure software development and platform operations meet regulatory, audit, resilience and compliance expectations.

Skills & Experience

  • Senior engineering leadership experience in payments, cards or highly regulated financial technology environments.

  • Proven experience establishing, scaling and operating engineering teams, standards and practices.

  • Direct experience integrating with, building against or operating connectivity to payment schemes or rails. Relevant examples include Faster Payments, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK; SEPA payment schemes and associated euro payment infrastructure in Europe; ACH or Fedwire in the US; or card networks and associated issuing or acquiring infrastructure. Alternatively, substantial experience delivering payment connectivity through a provider such as Form3 or an equivalent platform, with demonstrable technical depth in how payments are processed, routed and operated.

  • Experience delivering or operating digital wallet capabilities, such as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

  • Strong understanding of real-time, high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Strong background working in regulated environments, with practical experience of audit, compliance, operational resilience and control frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of shift-left quality, test automation, modern quality engineering and secure software development practices.

  • Experience using modern AI-enabled engineering tooling and a strong understanding of how agentic or multi-agent approaches can improve software development, testing and engineering delivery in a controlled and responsible way.

  • Strong security mindset, with an appreciation of evolving threats, mitigations and secure platform design.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence across multiple teams and senior stakeholders, including where direct line management is not present.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, risk, compliance and executive stakeholders.

  • Sound judgement in balancing delivery pace, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, operational risk and engineering quality.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!

Chargé(e) support Assurance Qualité

Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair.

Ce poste proposé en CDI requiert une présence sur site 3 fois par semaine.

Support à la documentation qualité

  • Coordonner la revue, la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures qualité (SOPs) avec les équipes opérationnelles et les auteurs des documents.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéances, anticiper les besoins et réaliser les relances nécessaires.
  • Garantir une communication fluide entre les équipes métiers et le département Assurance Qualité.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du système documentaire.

Archivage des données d'études

  • Identifier et planifier les besoins d'archivage liés aux données d'études passées et futures.
  • Mettre en œuvre les activités d'archivage conformément aux procédures qualité en vigueur.
  • Suivre la réalisation des opérations d'archivage et assurer leur conformité.
  • Participer à la standardisation des processus et coordonner les actions avec les équipes Document & Information Management.

Coordination de projets et workshops

  • Assurer le suivi des plans d'actions issus des groupes de travail dédiés aux nouvelles méthodes de travail.
  • Coordonner les échanges avec les différents responsables de workshops.
  • Consolider les éléments de reporting et contribuer à la restitution des résultats.
  • Favoriser la cohérence et l'efficacité des démarches engagées.

Requirements

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d’audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant.

Expérience : Une première expérience ou d’une expérience confirmée dans la coordination documentaire, l’assurance qualité, le document management, les opérations qualité ou un environnement réglementé des Life Sciences.

Connaissances Qualité : Une connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité, de l’environnement GxP, des SOPs et des exigences de traçabilité documentaire constitue un véritable atout.

Gestion documentaire : Capacité à coordonner la rédaction, la revue et la mise à jour de documents qualité, à suivre les échéances et à assurer la conformité des processus documentaires.

Coordination de projets : Expérience dans le pilotage d’actions transverses, le suivi de plans d’actions ou la coordination de groupes de travail impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) ainsi que de SharePoint. Une expérience de gestion documentaire ou de suivi de processus qualité est appréciée.

Qualités personnelles : Excellent sens de l’organisation, rigueur, autonomie, esprit de synthèse et capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous faites preuve de proactivité et savez assurer un suivi efficace des actions confiées.

Relationnel : Aisance à travailler en transverse avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires, excellent sens de la communication et capacité à fédérer différents interlocuteurs autour d’objectifs communs.

Langues : Anglais technique requis (lecture et rédaction de documentation). Un niveau conversationnel est un plus dans un contexte international.

Benefits

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.
