Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur.

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Rejoignez-nous aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate !

jobs.description:
Accounting & Administration Specialist

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting & Administration Specialist based in France.

As an Accounting & Administration Specialist, you will play an essential role in ensuring accurate, efficient, and reliable financial operations within a growing international organization. Working closely with the Head of the Department, you will oversee general accounting activities, invoicing, accounts receivable, and payment collection. You will contribute to financial reporting, period-end closings, and intercompany reconciliations while helping maintain strong financial controls. Beyond daily operations, you will identify opportunities to improve, automate, and streamline accounting and administrative processes. You will also support the integration of newly acquired entities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple European markets. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional seeking to take ownership, develop their expertise, and make a meaningful impact in an international environment.


Accountabilities:

You will ensure the accuracy and efficiency of accounting, invoicing, and collection activities while supporting financial reporting and the continuous improvement of departmental processes.

  • Manage general accounting activities using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, including journal entries, bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, accruals, and provisions.

  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closings, ensuring accurate financial records, and assist with tax documentation, financial audits, and account reviews while identifying discrepancies and potential risks.

  • Prepare and review domestic and international client invoices, coordinate with consulting teams to ensure timely billing, monitor outstanding payments, and manage debt collection activities in Spanish and English.

  • Handle intercompany accounting and reconciliations, contribute to management reports and financial analyses, and identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting and administrative processes, including supporting the integration of newly acquired companies.

    • Requirements:

    You are an organized and proactive accounting professional with solid technical knowledge, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial processes independently. You are comfortable working in an international environment and communicating with clients, suppliers, and colleagues across different markets.

  • Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 3 years of experience in accounting and administration, preferably within a services company, consultancy, or international organization.

  • Essential hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, particularly in accounting, purchasing, sales, and invoicing.

  • Demonstrated experience in invoicing, accounts receivable management, and payment collection.

  • Fluency in Spanish (C1 or higher) and advanced English proficiency (C1), both written and spoken.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

  • Experience with intercompany accounting, international invoicing, or multinational environments is highly valued.

  • Knowledge of Power BI or other reporting and automation tools is an advantage.

  • Strong accounting judgment, attention to detail, autonomy, and organizational skills.

  • Proactive mindset, excellent communication abilities, and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time, permanent employment opportunity.

  • Remote working arrangements.

  • Gross annual salary of €28,000–€30,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Opportunity to join a growing international organization with a strong presence across Europe.

  • Direct collaboration with the Head of the Department and teams across the organization.

  • Involvement in meaningful process improvement, automation, and business integration initiatives.

  • Opportunities for professional development, increasing responsibility, and long-term career growth

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer

This role may require in-person interview/s.

About Osano:

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build and improve Osano AI, our intelligent privacy assistant. As part of the Osano AI team, you will take capabilities from first idea to production, with an emphasis on delivering capabilities that are reliable, measurable, and trustworthy.

This role goes beyond wrapping APIs or building chat interfaces. We are looking for an engineer who has shipped LLM-powered systems that real users depend on. That means that you’ve dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost, evaluation, and tricky edge cases within agentic systems, and you know what it takes to keep these non-deterministic systems working after launch.

You will often work on problems that aren’t well-defined. Success here depends on how you think, communicate, and work with others as much as on what you build. This position is ideal for someone who is highly technical, thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of 0→1 initiatives, wants to have an outsized impact, and believes responsible AI is non-negotiable.

Responsibilities:

Build and ship production AI

  • Design, build, and maintain agentic features across our products, from early prototype to scaled production deployments.
  • Build retrieval (RAG) systems that build trust through verifiable sources.
  • Build agentic and multi-step workflows with guardrails, observability, and structured outputs.
  • Balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost in production.

Measure and improve AI systems

  • Build thorough evaluation frameworks that cover accuracy, grounding, latency, and reliability, utilizing both offline evaluations and real-world production signals.
  • Deploy data-driven methods to decide what to ship, how to fix it, and what to stop doing.
  • Continuously refine deployed systems based on measurable outcomes.

Collaborate and communicate

  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, privacy experts, and other stakeholders to decide what to build, how to build it, and why.
  • Write clear design documents and run effective technical discussions.

Privacy-First Development

  • Embed privacy-by-design principles across the AI stack.
  • Ensure compliance, data sovereignty, and secure handling practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align AI capabilities with regulatory standards.

About You:

  • You’re curious, self-directed, and motivated to learn quickly.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and creating clarity for others.
  • You’re excited about privacy, responsible AI, and building trustworthy technology.
  • You are willing to relentlessly pursue the best, most responsible ways to leverage AI—without overselling its capabilities or ignoring its limitations.

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering or AI/ML experience
  • Demonstrated experience building and running agentic systems in production with real users, not just prototypes or internal demos.
  • Deep technical understanding of LLM usage and orchestration beyond prompt engineering.
  • Proven experience building complex RAG systems and autonomous AI agents.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Concrete examples of getting from ambiguity to results.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Strong expertise in the Python AI ecosystem, including FastAPI and LangGraph.
  • Experience with Knowledge Graphs to enhance RAG precision
  • Familiarity with Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs)
  • Experience with data anonymization techniques
  • Background in compliance-heavy or regulated environments

Why Us:

  • We're a welcoming team that's dependable, curious, moves fast, and full of talented people
  • We're a B-corporation with a mission that matters, in a high-growth space with significant potential
  • You'll have access to our training program, well-defined career paths, and a leadership team that values professional development

Benefits:

  • Competitive-pay compensation and ownership interest/equity
  • Unlimited paid time off, plus a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year
  • We're a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums on base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance via Aetna
  • A fully and permanently remote company, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook and $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness and talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
Technical Marketing Engineer

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.description:
Senior transformatieconsultant

0,8 tot 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | € 5.086 - € 7.800 | Transformatie van organisaties | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat.

Als senior transformatieconsultant begeleid je complexe en vaak meerjarige veranderprogramma’s bij grote organisaties. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie en uitvoering, verbindt experts vanuit verschillende vakgebieden en helpt opdrachtgevers om het transitieproces met succes te implementeren.

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

Dit ga je doen

Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan

Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. Het doel is om de organisatie duurzaam anders te laten functioneren, zodat zij beter kan inspelen op nieuwe strategische uitdagingen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse regie op omvangrijke verandertrajecten bij opdrachtgevers. Vaak gaat het om programma’s die meerdere jaren lopen en waarbij meerdere organisatieonderdelen betrokken zijn. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, organisatie-inrichting, processen & technologie, hr-processen, organisatiedynamiek en leiderschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat verandering niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd.

Je verbindt mensen en expertise

De kracht van Berenschot zit in de combinatie van verschillende expertises. Afhankelijk van de opgave werk je samen met collega's op het gebied van organisatieontwikkeling, hr, leiderschap, cultuur, data-analyse, functiewaardering, bedrijfsvoering en collega’s uit specifieke sectoren. Denk daarbij aan openbaar bestuur, bedrijfsleven en energie & leefomgeving.

Jij brengt deze expertise samen rond één gezamenlijke ambitie. Je creëert structuur, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat mensen elkaar versterken en resultaten worden behaald.

Je bent een vertrouwde gesprekspartner voor bestuurders

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen.

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties

Naast je opdrachten draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze propositie. Je deelt kennis, ontwikkelt nieuwe aanpakken en begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s in hun professionele groei.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt te werken binnen de adviesgroep Transformaties van organisaties. Vanuit verschillende expertisegebieden werken we samen aan complexe veranderopgaven bij onze klanten. Vaak gebeurt dit onder regie van een transformatiepartner of programmamanager.

Wij geloven dat duurzame verandering alleen lukt wanneer strategie, organisatiestructuur, processen, systemen, hr, cultuur en leiderschap in samenhang worden aangepakt. Daarom werken we nadrukkelijk multidisciplinair en zoeken we collega’s die energie krijgen van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en expertise.

Je werkt regelmatig zelfstandig bij de klant, maar bent nooit alleen. Achter je staat een sterk netwerk van collega’s dat je kunt inzetten wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Juist die combinatie van zelfstandigheid, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk zo bijzonder.


Dit neem je mee

  • Een academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal zes jaar ervaring met complexe verander-, transformatie- of reorganisatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld als programmamanager, verandermanager of transformatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van omvangrijke programma’s binnen complexe organisaties en stakeholderomgevingen.

  • Het vermogen om verschillende expertises, belangen en mensen samen te brengen rond een gezamenlijke opgave.

  • Ondernemerschap en gevoel voor kansen in de markt. Je bouwt graag aan klantrelaties en duurzame samenwerkingen.

  • Verbindend leiderschap en een uitmuntend teamplayerschap. Je brengt rust, overzicht en vertrouwen, ook wanneer de omgeving dynamisch of politiek gevoelig is.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 5.086– en € 7.800,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • een representatievergoeding van € 3.000,- per jaar

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een mobiliteitsregeling naar keuze: een auto van de zaak of een mobiliteitsbudget

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Krijg jij energie van het begeleiden van complexe organisatieveranderingen? Vind je het leuk om mensen, expertise en belangen samen te brengen en langdurig samen te werken met klanten aan duurzame resultaten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen.

Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om een assessment te maken. Blijkt daaruit dat jij goed past bij Berenschot en onze manier van werken? Dan doen we je graag een passend aanbod.

Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je van harte welkom in ons team.

jobs.title: Junior Account Executive
jobs.description:
Junior Account Executive

We help churches develop. Behind every church are people who give their time and heart to their community, and we want to make their work easier. Our software brings administration and communication together in one platform, so there’s less time for paperwork and more time for people.

More than 10,000 churches across Europe work with ChurchDesk, and together with Hagru we’re now growing fast in the Netherlands. Our Groningen team is at the heart of that growth, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it.

Is this you?
You’ve just graduated or are about to, or you have your first work experience behind you. You love talking to people, you’re curious, and you want a job where you learn fast and see the results of your work. You don’t need years of sales experience. We’ll teach you how to sell. What we’re looking for is your energy, your curiosity and your drive to grow.

About your new role

  • Open doors: You reach out to churches and congregations across the Netherlands that don’t use ChurchDesk or Hagru yet.

  • Start real conversations: You learn about their daily work, their challenges and their plans, and show them how our platform can make life easier.

  • Own the process: You guide churches from the first conversation all the way to signing, and you hand them over smoothly to onboarding.

  • Present with confidence: You present ChurchDesk to church councils, staff and volunteers, online and in person.

  • Build relationships: You become a trusted partner in the Dutch church landscape and build relationships that last.

  • Learn every day: With training in consultative selling and your own coach, you’ll quickly develop into a confident sales professional.


  • A degree (or soon one) in any field, for example business, communication, theology or social sciences, or first work experience in a people-facing role.

  • First sales or customer experience is a plus, for example from a student job, an internship or a study association, but it’s not a must.

  • You’re outgoing, enjoy talking to new people and don’t give up easily.

  • You’re structured, take ownership and like working towards clear goals.

  • Fluent Dutch and good English, plus strong communication skills in conversations and in writing.

  • A connection to church life, whether through your own church, volunteering or a student association, is a real plus.

What We Offer

  • A great start to your career: Training in consultative selling and a dedicated coach who helps you grow.

  • Real responsibility from day one in a growing international tech company.

  • Open feedback culture: We’re transparent, supportive and learn from each other.

  • 30 days of vacation, because rest matters.

  • Trust and flexibility: We focus on results, not on counting hours, with a Scandinavian focus on balance.

  • Fancy a change of scenery? Visit our offices in Copenhagen, Berlin or Oslo, with travel and expenses covered.

  • Unforgettable team experiences: company events, sailing trips in Croatia, ski trips and visits to our Berlin office.

  • A diverse team of different nationalities, ages and backgrounds, and a great office crew in Groningen.

Ready to start?
Apply with your CV. A cover letter is optional, but we’d love to hear in a few lines why you want to start your career in sales with us. We look forward to meeting you!

About ChurchDesk

At ChurchDesk, we believe that the church plays an important role in society. Our platform is used by thousands of congregations to organise their work, improve communication with members, reach more people, and unlock new ways of fundraising.
Our customers are part of one of the largest and oldest institutions in the world: the Church. ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

Manager, WW Distribution

Our team sits at the center of how Rubrik goes to market. We own the quote-to-cash experience for Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance, ensuring reps and partners can quote and order quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. We work with Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, Supply Chain, and our distributor partners to turn complex order and pricing scenarios into clear, repeatable processes.

We value clear thinking, ownership, and a bias for making the field's job easier. If you thrive under deadline pressure, enjoy unblocking deals, and like building the processes that keep a global distribution model running smoothly this could be a great fit.

About the role:

The Manager, WW Distribution is the operational link between Rubrik's sales and channel teams and our global distributors. You will serve as the go-to resource for international order and quoting questions, own distributor escalations, and keep pricing information current as hardware costs move. This role is central to closing deals at month and quarter end and to scaling Rubrik's distribution processes as the business grows.

What you'll do:

  • International process support â Serve as the go-to point of contact for sales reps' day-to-day questions on international order and quoting processes, ensuring consistent, timely guidance across regions
  • Distributor escalations â Own escalation management with distributor partners on urgent quotes or orders, driving fast resolution to keep deals moving
  • DistiOperations alias coverage â Monitor and respond to requests coming into the distiops alias, triaging and resolving issues or routing to the right team
  • EOM/EOQ deal support â Partner closely with US sales teams to shepherd deals across the finish line during month- and quarter-end crunch, unblocking order processing issues under time pressure
  • HW price increase & IBP management â Communicate hardware price increases to the field, update the IBP in the system accordingly, and communicate order cutoff dates so reps and distributors have accurate, current pricing information. Given constrained commodity supply, which is projected to be sold out through 2028, this is now a monthly exercise rather than the approximately twice-a-year cadence of the past
  • SW3P process support â Answer sales questions on the SW3P process, including partner imaging as we work to scale it

Experience you'll need:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Order Management, Deal Desk, or Channel/Distribution Operations, with strong knowledge of the quote-to-order lifecycle and operating in a 2-tier channel ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience working with distributors and channel partners, including managing urgent escalations to resolution
  • Familiarity with international order, quoting, and pricing processes across multiple regions
  • Working knowledge of quoting and order systems (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) and the ability to troubleshoot order processing issues
  • Ability to stay calm, prioritize, and execute in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, particularly at month and quarter end
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to partner with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and partner teams and communicate pricing and policy changes clearly and on time
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a process-oriented mindset and a drive to improve and scale how work gets done
  • Experience with hardware pricing, supply chain, or IBP/price list management is a plus
  • Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment is preferred

jobs.title: Account Manager, Scale
jobs.description:
Account Manager, Scale

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Team Overview:
The Braze ANZ Account Management team drives commercial growth and retention across our existing customer base. In this role you will own a portfolio of established mid market customers, operating as a commercial partner who helps them mature their use of Braze and convert that maturity into growth. Success comes from breadth and rhythm, knowing your book well enough to spot where value is stalling and where the next opportunity sits.

Responsibilities:

  • Own a portfolio of mid market customers across ANZ, with full accountability for renewal, upsell and cross sell
  • Prioritise ruthlessly across the book, directing time and executive attention to the accounts where growth or risk is most material
  • Generate your own expansion pipeline through usage analysis, whitespace mapping and maturity assessment
  • Build durable relationships with marketing, CRM and digital leadership, and multi thread beyond a single champion
  • Partner with Customer Success to run account plans and business reviews that connect Braze performance to customer outcomes
  • Develop tailored commercial proposals and lead renewal and expansion negotiations to close
  • Identify retention risk early using adoption signals, account health and stakeholder change
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly expansion and retention targets
  • Maintain accurate forecasts with a clear view of deal progression, risk and timing
  • Build repeatable plays that hold across a larger book rather than one off approaches
  • Lead customer meetings virtually and in person, with regular domestic and occasional international travel

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercially minded Account Manager who enjoys running a busy book and knows where the growth is hiding in it. You have a proven record of expanding SaaS accounts, you are comfortable owning a number in a fast moving environment, and you work well across functions..

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in SaaS sales, account management or similar, with demonstrated success driving revenue growth and retention
  • Minimum 3 years owning SaaS customer relationships end to end, including accountability for renewals, upsell and expansion
  • Experience managing portfolios with annual contract values from 150K to 500K
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding commercial targets in fast paced, high growth environments
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and sell value to senior marketing, CRM and digital stakeholders
  • Experience in the Martech, Adtech or broader CX space is highly regarded, including CRM, marketing automation, customer analytics, email or content marketing
  • Excellent collaborator with a proven ability to work across Customer Success, Services, Marketing, Partnerships and Sales
  • Exceptional communicator, a confident presenter, persuasive writer and trusted relationship builder with strong verbal, written and numerical fluency
  • Strong organisational and time management skills, comfortable managing competing priorities across a broad portfolio
  • Self starter with a high level of accountability, drive and commercial acumen

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

Thousands of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

 

What you'll do

  • Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility.

  • Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place.

  • Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging.

  • Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next.

  • Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

  • Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else.

 

What you should have

  • You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am.

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences.

 

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

 

How we build with AI

Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team:

  • Checkly and the agentic software layer: Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents.

  • Your software factory stops at deploy: Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix.

  • We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go: Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents.

  • Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool: Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

 

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €107k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

 

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

Compensation: €79K – €107K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

jobs.title: Werkstudent - Growth/ Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent - Growth/ Marketing (m/w/d)

Du möchtest nicht nur Content produzieren, sondern mitgestalten, wie ein Unternehmen seine Geschichte erzählt und wächst? Bei nu estate verbindest du kreative Ideen, gutes Design und digitales Marketing. Du machst Themen rund um Immobilien, Technologie und KI verständlich und hilfst uns dabei, die richtigen Menschen zu erreichen.

Über nu estate

Wir wollen ein KI-natives Betriebssystem für die Immobilienverwaltung aufbauen. Dabei denken wir Technologie und die operative Bewirtschaftung von Immobilien zusammen: Was brauchen Eigentümer, Mieter und Dienstleister tatsächlich – und wie lassen sich ihre Anliegen einfacher, transparenter und zuverlässiger bearbeiten?

Unser Ziel geht über weniger Verwaltungsaufwand hinaus. Eine belastbare Datenbasis soll langfristig auch helfen, Immobilien besser zu bewirtschaften und fundierte Entscheidungen über ihre Weiterentwicklung zu treffen. Dafür verbinden wir Immobilienpraxis mit Produktentwicklung, Datenanalyse und KI.

Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent unterstützt du uns dabei, die Marke nu estate sichtbar und unsere Ideen greifbar zu machen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content, Gestaltung und Kommunikation. Du recherchierst Themen, entwickelst Formate und bereitest Inhalte für die Menschen auf, die sich für Immobilienbewirtschaftung und ihre Zukunft interessieren.

Daneben unterstützt du ausgewählte Growth-Projekte, etwa Materialien für Partner, kleinere Kampagnen oder Veranstaltungen. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und probierst aus, welche Inhalte und Formate tatsächlich funktionieren. Dabei geht es nicht darum, jeden Kanal gleichzeitig zu bespielen, sondern die richtigen Themen für die passenden Zielgruppen zu finden.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

  • Themen entdecken und Geschichten erzählen: Du recherchierst zu Immobilien, Technologie und KI und übersetzt komplexe Sachverhalte in verständliche, relevante Inhalte für unsere Zielgruppen.

  • Content gestalten: Du schreibst und bearbeitest Texte, erstellst Grafiken und Präsentationen und unterstützt bei Bedarf bei kurzen Videos – von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Beitrag.

  • Kanäle und Formate betreuen: Du pflegst einen Redaktionsplan, bereitest Beiträge für ausgewählte Kanäle wie LinkedIn oder die Website vor und begleitest ihre Veröffentlichung in Abstimmung mit dem Team.

  • Die Marke mitgestalten: Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Designvorgaben und Vorlagen und sorgst dafür, dass Inhalte und Marketingmaterialien visuell und sprachlich zusammenpassen. Erfahrung mit Gestaltungs- oder Videotools wie Canva, Figma oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.

  • Growth-Projekte unterstützen: Du recherchierst Zielgruppen und potenzielle Partner und hilfst bei der Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Kampagnen oder Veranstaltungen.

  • Aus Ergebnissen lernen: Du hältst einfache Kennzahlen und Rückmeldungen fest und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, wie sich Inhalte und Formate verbessern lassen.

  • KI bewusst nutzen: Du setzt digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Recherche, Ideen und Produktion ein und prüfst Fakten, Qualität und Nutzungsrechte, bevor Inhalte veröffentlicht werden.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschrieben; beispielsweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Design, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du hast Freude daran, verständlich zu schreiben und Inhalte visuell ansprechend zu gestalten. Erste Beispiele können aus dem Studium, einem Nebenjob oder eigenen Projekten stammen.

  • Du hast ein Gespür dafür, was eine Zielgruppe interessiert, und möchtest herausfinden, wie man komplexe Themen einfach erklärt.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig: Du bringst Ideen ein, hältst Absprachen ein und achtest auch bei Details auf Qualität.

  • Du nutzt digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge oder hast Lust, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Ergebnisse prüfst du kritisch, statt sie ungeprüft zu übernehmen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Immobilien und Technologie und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein. Vorkenntnisse in der Immobilienwirtschaft sind kein Muss.

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen auszuprobieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte: Erste Erfahrung mit Canva, Figma oder ähnlichen Design- und Videotools, Social Media, Website-Pflege, Newslettern oder der Auswertung von Marketingkennzahlen. Du musst nicht alle Werkzeuge bereits beherrschen, wichtiger sind Kreativität, Lernbereitschaft und ein sorgfältiger Umgang mit deiner Arbeit.

Was die Arbeit bei uns ausmacht

  • Konkreter Nutzen: Deine Inhalte helfen dabei, unsere Arbeit und ihren Nutzen für Eigentümer und Partner verständlich zu machen.

  • Verantwortung mit Rückhalt: Du übernimmst überschaubare Aufgaben und Formate und stimmst Ziele, Inhalte und offene Fragen mit dem Team ab.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Lernkurve: Du kannst Ideen einbringen, neue Formate ausprobieren und Einblicke in Marketing, Immobilien und Technologie gewinnen.

  • Tempo mit Qualitätsanspruch: Wir wollen Ergebnisse früh testen und daraus lernen. Sorgfalt, verlässliche Aussagen und ein konsistenter Auftritt gehören dazu.

  • Offenheit und Verbindlichkeit: Wir kommunizieren klar, geben ehrliches Feedback und arbeiten respektvoll und auf Augenhöhe zusammen.

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns auf eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Lebenslauf und – falls vorhanden – ein oder zwei Arbeitsproben, etwa einen Text, eine Grafik oder ein Content-Projekt. Besonders spannend: Was war deine Idee, für wen war sie gedacht und was war dein eigener Beitrag?

Vergütung

Für diese Werkstudententätigkeit gilt ein Stundenlohn von EUR 15–20 pro Stunde.

jobs.description:
Deployment Lead, Semiconductors - London

About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships.

About the Role

As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel between 25-50% is required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent work streams, translating customer objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Run day-to-day engineering execution by tracking and driving delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

  • Embed with Semiconductor customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan.

  • Shape production deployments that integrate with customer infrastructure, data systems, and engineering toolchains, including export-controlled environments.

  • Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research work streams land in time to support deployment goals.

  • Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

  • Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

  • Help define how OpenAI engages Semiconductor customers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

  • Have deep expertise in Semiconductor workflows, including RTL design, verification, EDA tooling, and physical implementation.

  • Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

  • Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

  • Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

  • Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognize broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

  • Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

  • You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - London
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - London

About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems.

About the Role

You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions.

You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will:

  • Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review.

  • Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates.

  • Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence.

  • Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt.

     

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software.

  • Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering.

  • Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security.

  • Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes.

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders.

Additional experience includes:

Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas:

  • Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment.

  • Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners.

  • Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities.

  • Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases.

  • Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior.

  • Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust.

  • Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research.

  • Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Manager - Transaction Services
jobs.description:
Manager - Transaction Services

About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

Unity Advisory is a new kind of partner for the office of the CFO. Founded by senior leaders from the world's top advisory firms and backed by Warburg Pincus, we provide integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support: expert advice, sharper execution, and delivery models built around how organisations operate today. CFOs need trusted advisers without legacy complexity, so we pair expert human judgement with proprietary AI workflows and smart automation, free from audit conflicts.

The Role

We built our deals practice around the client's decision: whether to buy, whether to sell, at what price, on what terms. We work alongside our clients rather than at arm's length, in the room while the deal decision is being made, and our support carries on beyond signing: into the 100-day plan, the hold period and the eventual exit. And that support draws on the whole firm: our tax, finance and commercial specialists work as one team with the deals practice, so the advice a client gets after signing is as integrated as the diligence that came before it.

We're looking for a Manager to join our Financial Due Diligence team. You'll run buy-side and sell-side engagements day to day: getting into the numbers, managing the team on the ground, and making sure clients get clear, well-supported findings on time.

You'll bring solid FDD or transaction services experience from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm, and own an engagement from scoping through to final findings. You'll work alongside our Partners and Directors and directly with clients and target company management from day one. This is a hybrid role based in our Mayfair office.

What You'll Do

• Manage buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements from scoping through to completion.

• Analyse quality of earnings, net working capital, cash flow and other issues that decide a deal, and turn the findings into a clear, well-supported story for the client.

• Run the engagement team day to day: reviewing work, coaching junior staff, and keeping everyone (including the client) up to speed on progress.

• Interview target company management and build working relationships with clients, private equity investors, and other advisors on the deal.

• Draft and quality-check diligence deliverables so they're accurate, clear, and ready for Director or Partner sign-off.

• Work alongside Unity's data and AI specialists to make our analytics standard practice on every engagement.

• Take part in business development: proposals, pitches, and staying close to opportunities as they arise.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years' experience in Financial Due Diligence or Transaction Services from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm.

• Hands-on experience managing buy-side and sell-side FDD assignments from start to finish.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting and the deal issues that matter most: quality of earnings, working capital, and cash flow.

• A track record of being an excellent team player in multidisciplinary engagements.

• Clear and confident communication (both written and verbal) with clients and senior stakeholders.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in how technology and AI evolve financial due diligence practice and playing a key role in shaping it.

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

Nice to Have

• Experience with Private Equity clients or PE-backed portfolio companies.

• Exposure to cross-border or international transactions.

• Experience with data and analytics tools such as Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks.

• Sector experience in areas like TMT, Consumer, Healthcare, Business Services and Industrials.

Additional Information

 

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

 

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

jobs.description:
Admin (Legacy)

About Marble

Marble creates hard tech companies for the New Climate Era, across energy, industry and resilience. Since 2021, we have launched 15 companies backed by some of the best investors across Europe and North America.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate to drive venture creation across multiple opportunity areas in physical AI, robotics, and autonomy in a broad range of sectors (e.g. energy, logistics, construction, manufacturing, mining, etc)

Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.

Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Location: Paris, France (occasional travel for events)

Language: Fluent English required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or computer scientist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various domains where intelligent systems interact with the physical world:

  • Technical expertise in AI/ML applied to physical systems, robotics and autonomy. You hold a PhD or MS in Computer Science (ML/RL), Robotics, or related (EEng, MechEng), with applied experience in startup or industry.

  • Experience shipping systems in a real-world environment. You understand operational constraints such as safety, uptime and latency, human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations with other systems.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in physical industries, AI and climate infrastructure.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply unless they feel they meet every single qualification. If you are excited about the opportunity but your experience does not align perfectly - please apply anyway!
