SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

jobs.title: Senior Credit & Risk Associate
jobs.description:
Senior Credit & Risk Associate

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank

What you can expect

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our ClearBank Europe’s Operations team as a Senior Credit & Risk Associate?

Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, you will be at the centre of the day-to-day credit lifecycle. You will own and execute the core credit assessment, monitoring and provisioning activities that support sound lending decisions, and you will coordinate the information and hand-offs required across Sales, Finance & Treasury, and Risk. Alongside this, you will support the management of ClearBank Europe’s operational risk environment, risks and controls, operational risk events, issues and actions, and evidence of control effectiveness across the Operations function. The role in a nutshell: you produce, operate and coordinate the first-line credit process; working closely with second line as they provide independent review and challenge.

Your role includes:

Creditworthiness assessment and underwriting

  • Own the creditworthiness assessment model specifications and the supporting assessment tool, keeping the methodology and practical execution aligned.

  • Execute creditworthiness assessments for onboarding and periodic reviews, including gathering and assessing the required client inputs and translating the outcome into a clear credit conclusion.

  • Prepare the first-line overdraft / credit proposal, inc luding the proposed limit and the analysis supporting the recommendation, and coordinate the proposal through the relevant approval process.

  • Coordinate credit onboarding once approved, ensuring agreed credit terms and the relevant operational hand-offs are clear to the teams involved.

Early warning, portfolio monitoring & provisioning

  • Own and operate the Early Warning Indicator assessment process and investigate triggered cases.

  • Maintain visibility of Watch List and Default cases, ensuring appropriate escalation and hand-off.

  • Produce first-line credit risk monitoring across the portfolio, identifying changes in exposure, concentrations and emerging risks.

  • Coordinate annual credit reviews, renewals and exits.

  • Support NPE and forbearance management through appropriate first-line analysis, case history and supporting data.

Credit risk framework and pricing

  • Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures.

  • Translate relevant policy requirements into practical processes, tools, controls and monitoring.

  • Coordinate periodic review of relevant interest-rate spreads and overdraft fees with Finance & Treasury.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process.

Risk & Controls

  • Support the ongoing development of Operations risk and control within ClearBank Europe, ensuring operational risks, controls and residual-risk assessments remain current, appropriately evidenced and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Work with risk and control owners to assess inherent risk, control design and effectiveness, and residual risk, providing constructive first-line challenge where required.

  • Maintain oversight of locally operated, Group and outsourced controls, ensuring ClearBank Europe has appropriate evidence and entity-level oversight.

  • Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment.

What does success in this role look like?

  • Credit assessments and proposals are timely, well evidenced and decision-ready, with a clear audit trail from client information through to conclusion and limit recommendation.

  • Daily EWI monitoring and annual reviews operate reliably, with Watch List, Default, renewal and exit cases identified and progressed without unnecessary delay.

  • The first-line credit framework, models and tools remain practical, current and consistently applied as the lending portfolio develops.

  • Stakeholders have a clear view of case status, responsibilities and next steps because you actively coordinate the credit lifecycle rather than simply completing individual analyses.

  • There is clear separation between first-line ownership and second-line independent challenge, while the two roles work together effectively to keep the portfolio within approved risk appetite.

  • Robust, current and well-evidenced operational risk and control environment, proactively identifying emerging risks and control weaknesses and ensuring appropriate actions are taken to address them.

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience in credit analysis, underwriting, portfolio monitoring or a closely related first-line credit role within banking or regulated financial services.

  • Strong ability to analyse financial and non-financial information and convert it into a concise, evidence-based credit view and recommendation.

  • Working knowledge of business or institutional lending products and the risk drivers associated with limits, overdrafts or comparable credit exposures.

  • Practical understanding of early-warning monitoring, Watch List / Default concepts and the credit lifecycle from onboarding through periodic review, renewal and exit.

  • Working knowledge of IFRS 9 provisioning and staging, with the ability to operate models and investigate or explain outcomes. Model ownership or methodology experience is an advantage.

  • Having some financial crime risk background within a regulated institution is also nice to have.

  • Strong organisation and stakeholder coordination skills. You are comfortable driving inputs and actions across Sales, Operations, Finance & Treasury, Risk and governance forums.

  • A can-do attitude geared to execution, with strong attention to detail and the judgement to know when an issue needs escalation.

  • Comfort working in a growing bank where processes and products continue to evolve, and the willingness to improve them as you go.

What makes a great ClearBank team member?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly about the best result for customers, colleagues and the bank.

  • You seek feedback, assume positive intent and build strong, trusting relationships.

  • You care about quality, but you also know that progress matters: you learn, iterate and improve.

  • 'I' before 'we' is not in your vocabulary. You succeed through clear ownership and collaboration

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027

Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein.

Over Petite Amélie

Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk.

Wat ga je doen?

Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses:

  • Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties.

  • Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management.

  • Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren.

  • Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd.

  • SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren.

  • Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen.

Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op.

Wie zoeken we?

Dit heb je echt nodig:

  • Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst).

  • Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027.

  • Je woont in Nederland.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

Dit maakt je een goede match:

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel.

  • Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen.

  • Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen.

Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar.

Benefits

Dit bieden wij:

  • Een stagevergoeding van €650 per maand

  • Een OV-reisproduct of reiskostenvergoeding, en een laptop van de zaak

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een vaste begeleider uit het team

  • Praktijkervaring in de hele e-commerce-mix: influencer marketing, social, community management, merchandising, webshopbeheer, analytics, SEO en CRO

  • Een warm, enthousiast team waarin je werk echt impact heeft, en waar we successen graag samen vieren

Klaar om ons te komen versterken?

Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht.

Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten.

Vragen? Neem contact op met Jasmijn van den Heuvel, Country manager E-com & marketing NL, via -----

Software Engineer (starter)

Net afgestudeerd en al echte software gebouwd? Start bij een AI-startup vlak voor de lancering

Heb je tijdens je studie niet alleen opdrachten gemaakt, maar ook echt software gebouwd die mensen gebruiken? Als bijbaan, eigen project of startup? Dan zoeken we jou.

Squid Support is een AI-startup uit Nieuwegein. Onze AI-agent beantwoordt klantvragen voor webshops en handelt nu al duizenden berichten per dag af voor onze eerste klant, een snelgroeiende e-commerce-organisatie met meerdere webshops. We staan vlak voor de publieke lancering.

Waarom dit een goede eerste baan is

  • Je leert meer in een jaar bij ons dan in drie jaar bij een groot bedrijf

  • Je werkt elke dag direct met de oprichters

  • Wat je bouwt staat de volgende dag live, bij echte klanten

  • Je groeit mee met het bedrijf, en je rol groeit mee

Wat we zoeken

  • Een afgeronde of bijna afgeronde wo- of hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur informatica, AI of iets vergelijkbaars

  • Minimaal 1,5 jaar programmeerervaring met TypeScript en/of Python, bijbaan en eigen projecten tellen mee

  • Je bouwt dagelijks met Claude Code, Codex, Cursor of vergelijkbaar

  • Je hebt iets gebouwd dat echt gebruikt wordt, en daar wil je graag over vertellen

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands

Hoe we werken

We werken AI-native: Claude Code, Codex en agentic workflows zijn bij ons de standaard. Er zit geen product owner of projectmanager tussen jou en de klant. Je werkt elke dag direct met de oprichters.

Stack: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Docker. AI via onder andere OpenAI Agents SDK, LiteLLM en Vertex AI.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een plek in een klein, ambitieus team, net voor de lancering

  • Elke dag samenwerken met de oprichters, en veel leren

  • Echte ownership: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken klanten de volgende dag

  • Meegroeien met het bedrijf: als wij schalen, groeit jouw rol mee

  • €4.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, MacBook Pro en vrije keuze in AI-tooling

  • Hybride: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Nieuwegein

Stuur bij je sollicitatie een link mee naar iets wat je hebt gebouwd en wat echt gebruikt wordt.

jobs.description:
Data Center Construction Manager

About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the role

The Data Center Construction Manager will serve as Armada's on-site lead during the installation, startup, and commissioning phases of the Leviathan data center, driving the facility to Ready for Service (RFS). This role bridges traditional construction site management with data center startup and commissioning expertise, acting as the primary point of coordination between the customer's General Contractor (GC) and subcontracted trades, Armada's own subcontractors and trades, and the Commissioning Authority (CxA) team. The ideal candidate combines a strong construction management background with hands-on experience bringing mission-critical or industrial facilities from substantial completion through commissioning to RFS.

Location

  • This is an on-site, field-based role located at the Leviathan data center project site [Australia] for the duration of installation, startup, and commissioning.

  • Must be able to walk active construction sites, climb ladders/stairs, and work in mechanical/electrical spaces under construction; PPE required at all times.

  • Schedule may require extended hours, weekend work, and short-notice availability during critical energization and testing windows to support RFS milestones.

  • Travel requirements: [20-30%]

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Site Coordination & Construction Management

  • Serve as Armada's primary on-site point of contact, coordinating daily activities across the customer's GC, GC-managed subcontractors, and Armada's own subcontracted trades.

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce integrated site logistics plans, look-ahead schedules, and work sequencing across multiple concurrent trade crews.

  • Chair or participate in daily and weekly coordination meetings (OAC meetings, trade stacking, site safety huddles) to align GC, subcontractor, and commissioning schedules.

  • Identify and resolve field conflicts — space, sequencing, access, utility tie-ins — before they impact schedule.

  • Track and drive closure of punch lists, RFIs, and deficiency logs tied to startup readiness.

  • Maintain daily site reports, photo documentation, and progress logs for internal and customer stakeholders.

Commissioning Coordination (Path to RFS)

  • Serve as the field liaison to the Commissioning Authority (CxA), ensuring construction completion aligns with the Level 1–5 commissioning sequence.

  • Coordinate system turnover packages, startup sequencing, and system-by-system readiness with mechanical, electrical, controls, and fire/life safety trades.

  • Support and track execution of pre-functional checklists, functional performance testing (FPT), and integrated systems testing (IST).

  • Escalate and manage resolution of commissioning-driven punch items, ensuring trades remobilize quickly to close gaps.

  • Partner with the CxA, engineers of record, and OEM startup technicians to sequence equipment energization, startup, and testing safely and efficiently.

  • Maintain visibility into the master commissioning schedule and proactively flag risks to the RFS date.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Enforce site safety programs across all trades on site, including GC-managed and Armada-managed crews, in line with customer and jurisdictional requirements.

  • Ensure work is executed per approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards; support QA/QC inspections and documentation.

  • Support permitting, inspection, and AHJ (Authority Having Jurisdiction) coordination as needed to support system energization and occupancy.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Communication

  • Act as a trusted, credible technical and field voice across customer GC leadership, subcontractor superintendents, CxA teams, and Armada leadership.

  • Provide regular progress updates, schedule risk assessments, and RFS readiness reporting to Armada project leadership and the customer.

  • Support change management, ensuring field changes are documented and routed through proper approval channels.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of construction site management experience, including 3+ years focused on mission-critical, data center, or industrial startup/commissioning environments.

  • Proven track record coordinating multi-trade, multi-stakeholder job sites through substantial completion, startup, and commissioning to occupancy or RFS.

  • Working knowledge of data center MEP systems (electrical distribution/switchgear, UPS, generators, cooling plants/CRAH-CRAC, BMS/EPMS controls) sufficient to coordinate startup sequencing with the CxA and trades.

  • Familiarity with commissioning process frameworks (e.g., ASHRAE Guideline 0/1.1, Level 1–5 commissioning) and the ability to translate commissioning requirements into field execution plans.

  • Strong scheduling acumen (Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar) and experience managing look-ahead schedules across GC and subcontractor crews.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with general contractors, subcontractors, and third-party commissioning agents simultaneously.

  • OSHA 30 certification (or willingness to obtain); strong site safety leadership background.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting schedule and risk status to customer and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hyperscale or colocation data center construction/startup programs.

  • Working knowledge of building automation/controls systems and integrated systems testing (IST) processes.

  • Existing relationships with major data center GCs, CxA firms, and MEP trade contractors.

  • PMP, CxA, or CCM certification.

  • Experience owning or supporting RFS/turnover documentation packages (O&M manuals, as-builts, warranty documentation).

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. The Role

As the Senior Director of B2B Media Strategy, you will lead enterprise and growth-stage clients in translating complex business goals into measurable marketing outcomes. You’ll shape integrated go-to-market strategies that connect media, operations, and revenue alignment—ensuring impact from first impression to closed-won revenue.

Key areas of focus include:

  • Media strategy: Optimize media mix, audience segmentation, creative alignment, and measurement using advanced B2B martech, adtech, and datatech.
  • Operational consulting: Apply proven frameworks (maturity maps, resource models, digital transformation strategies) to design scalable martech, adtech, and datatech solutions.
  • Sales and marketing alignment: Deploy tactics that accelerate impression-to-revenue velocity across revenue teams.
  • Messaging alignment: Ensure the right audiences are matched with messaging that moves accounts into pipeline and ultimately closed-won revenue.

You’ll collaborate with channel specialists, client services, and analytics teams while engaging directly with sales and marketing leaders at client organizations. This role requires executive presence, deep B2B expertise, and the ability to bridge strategic vision with hands-on execution in fast-moving, competitive markets.

You Will Be

Media Strategy & Execution

  • Designing integrated B2B go-to-market media strategies that leverage paid, owned, and earned channels to drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
  • Leading cross-channel media efforts across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic (Display, Video, OTT, Audio, DOOH), SEO, content syndication, and PR.
  • Optimizing media mix, budget allocation, audience segmentation, creative alignment, and measurement plans tied to full-funnel performance—not just top-of-funnel KPIs.
  • Developing advanced audience strategies using ABM platforms (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense) and CRM/marketing automation data for precision targeting.
  • Championing continuous improvement through structured testing frameworks to validate messaging, audience targeting, and channel mix.

Operational Consulting & Design

  • Ability to collaborate with creative teams to ensure messaging aligns with buyer journeys, verticals, and personas.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager in the Chicagoland area to start and lead a new team that owns how we grow and manage the panels behind Recruit. Researchers come to Dscout to find the right participants, and some audiences are hard to reach. This team expands where those participants come from, and makes sure every recruit gets handled in the smartest way possible.

You'll own partner panel expansion, the addition of new recruit panels, and the smart router that decides what to do with a recruit based on its feasibility. You'll also own ongoing maintenance and new features for our existing panel partners. As we add panels, you'll lead the work to combine screener functionality, so researchers get one consistent experience across panels.

You bring the full PM toolkit—user research, roadmap and strategy, and cross-functional delivery. You pair it with real depth in marketplaces, partner integrations, and routing and matching systems, plus a hands-on feel for what LLMs can and can't do. You default to ownership: of the roadmap, of outcomes, and of the quality bar that decides whether a new panel or routing decision is ready to ship.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead the roadmap and strategy for panel expansion, from problem discovery through delivery and iteration
  • Evaluate and select new partner panels, weighing reach, cost, participant quality, and fit for hard-to-fill audiences
  • Lead the combination of screener functionality across partners, so researchers get one consistent experience
  • Define, ship, and evolve the smart router that decides how each recruit gets handled based on feasibility
  • Own the evaluation approach for routing and panel quality: set metrics, measure fill rates and participant quality by source
  • Own maintenance and new features for existing panel integrations
  • Manage partner relationships and dependencies, including redirects and postbacks that sit outside our control
  • Partner with the teams that own recruiting, matching, and Scout profiles, so panel and Scout supply work together
  • Use LLMs directly to prototype ideas, and shape system behavior through prompting and context design
  • Balance both sides of the marketplace, so changes that improve results for researchers stay fair and clear for participants
  • Track the metrics that matter: niche recruit fill rate, time to fill, cost per complete, and participant quality across sources
  • Partner with Design and Research on experiences that are usable and understandable, not just technically correct

What you bring

  • [5–8] years of product management experience, including owning a roadmap end-to-end from strategy through shipped outcomes
  • Experience owning marketplace, supply, or panel products—such as participant recruitment, ad networks, or two-sided platforms—and the tradeoffs between fill rate, cost, and quality
  • Experience working with external partners or vendors, including integrations, contracts, and dependencies you don't fully control
  • Comfort with routing, matching, or decisioning systems, and the logic that determines what happens to a request under different conditions
  • Strong judgment in managing complexity, and in creating consistent experiences across many partners and systems
  • Experience partnering with Engineering on architecture and integration tradeoffs as a peer
  • A high-ownership mindset: you treat outcomes, not deliverables, as your responsibility
  • The influence to align senior stakeholders, make hard calls with incomplete information, and coach other PMs

Nice to have

  • Experience in participant recruitment, panel management, or market research
  • Experience in B2B, ideally in a market adjacent to UX research, market research, or insights
  • Comfort with fast prototypes that get real usage early and then harden into the product, rather than big-spec-first processes

jobs.title: Product Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Product Engineer (m/f/x)

01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialise if AI, energy markets and industrial processes come together. Europe's largest industrial companies, together around 2% of Europe's energy demand, already make their energy decisions with RIZMO, the AI agent in our Energy OS.

As Product Engineer you build that product. You decide what we build and ship it to real industrial sites, with feedback straight from the customer and no ticket queue. We're hiring two of you.

02 · Meet Max, your CTO

I'm Max, CTO at RIZM. My team owns the whole product: intuitive workflows, strong algorithms, resilient infrastructure and an AI agent layer on top. What I love here is the speed: fast decisions, quick iterations and real responsibility for everyone. If you want to change how Europe's industry uses energy, I'd love to meet you.

Max

03 · What you'll build

  • Features end to end: Take user-facing features in Digital Twin, Designer, Operator and Portfolio Manager from idea to production.

  • AI agents that act: Build agents that read digital twins, run optimisations, explain plans and soon act on their own, made reliable with guardrails, grounding and evals on real customer data.

  • Data people understand: Turn simulations and live data from customers' IT/OT systems, markets and weather into clear charts, time series and maps.

04 · What you bring

  • Experience: 2–5 years building customer-facing products, taking complex features from idea to launch.

  • Tech skills: Strong TypeScript with Vue or React, at home across browser, Node and PostgreSQL, plus containers and CI/CD.

  • AI-native: You've shipped LLM features to real users and know their costs and failure modes. Claude Code and agents are part of your daily work.

  • Ownership: You care about design details, cut scope on your own and enjoy unclear problems. No energy background needed.

Our stack: Vue, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (Kubernetes, GitLab CI), LangGraph across several models, Julia and Python for optimisation and forecasting. You don't need to know Julia, just don't be scared of it.

05 · Why you should apply now

RIZM grew from a Stanford research project into a company whose software runs at sites like BMW and BSH. Demand is outpacing our team, so join now and shape what comes next.

  • Equity: A share in the company on top of your salary. We set your level during the process, not from your CV.

  • Top-tier investors: Sparring and mentoring through the Point 9 and Earlybird networks.

  • Team workation: Once a year, with talks from inspiring guests.

  • Into the field: See your software running at industrial sites.

06 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, these two things. No templates, no buzzwords.

  1. Give yourself 30 minutes and Claude Code. Build something small, useful or just fun, and send us the link or a screenshot with two lines on what it does.

  2. RIZMO is our AI agent that runs energy decisions for industrial sites. Which new skill would you give it tomorrow, and what's the biggest bottleneck to building it?

After that:

  • Intro call: 20 minutes on video to get to know each other.

  • Technical challenge: A hands-on task that shows how you think and build.

  • Technical deep dive: Your challenge, discussed with Max and the team.

  • A day with us: Build something together on site and meet a founder. Then we make you an offer.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, High Performance Data Systems
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer, High Performance Data Systems

About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

 

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

The role

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

The timing is rare. A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 150 and still accelerating, driven by massive demand. We are building the team to unlock our next orders of magnitude of scale and capability.

What you'll do

  • Own significant projects in our data systems end to end: design, architecture, deployment, monitoring and measuring the impact you made

  • Build distributed systems that stay fast and correct under load, and reason carefully about every way they can fail

  • Shape performant protocols and APIs, that customers build directly on top of

  • Find simple solutions to complex domains at scale, and know when boring technology wins

  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through code reviews, pairing and sharing what you know

Why engineers join Foundations

  • Scale that's genuinely hard. Multimodal AI data is big, messy and growing fast. You'll solve problems most backend engineers only read about.

  • Real ownership. You'll own whole systems, not tickets, and the architectural calls are yours to make.

  • Work that ships. Your systems power 300+ AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

  • Long-term thinking. A team that plans 24 months out and gives you room to build things properly.

  • The right moment. A Series C company growing fast, early enough that your decisions shape the platform for years.

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You combine rigorous engineering with ruthless prioritisation to ship efficient and correct systems quickly.

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • Fluency in at least one high level (Python, Typescript), and one imperative statically typed (Rust, C++, Java, Go, or other)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching, consistency) and how they behave under load

  • Deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

 

Operating principles

 

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

 

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer

Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
  • Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
  • Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
  • Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
  • Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
  • Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
  • Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
  • Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
  • Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
  • Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
  • Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
  • Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
  • Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined

About you

  • Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
  • Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.

  • Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
  • Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
  • Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
  • Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
  • Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)

WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Backend Platform team:

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python.

  • Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system.

  • Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

  • Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each.

  • Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact.

  • Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation.

  • Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team.

  • Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

  • Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both.

  • Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance.

  • Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind.

  • Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs).

  • Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes.

  • Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production.

  • A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking.

  • Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them.

  • Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early.

  • Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good.

It would be great if you have:

  • Experience on a Platform or Core team.

  • Strong production experience in both PHP and Python.

  • Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper).

  • Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts.

  • Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems.

  • Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools.

  • Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams.

jobs.description:
Accounting Manager

This role is part of our Central Finance Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

Our Central Finance team runs accounting, controlling and legal for a growing group of 17+ international entities. As Accounting Manager, you will report to our Director of Accounting & Tax, lead the GL team, and own accounting integration for every business we acquire, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration (PMI).

You will work closely with our CFO, the M&A and Controlling teams, external advisors and auditors, and the managing directors of many of our portfolio brands. Each new acquisition passes through your hands: you assess the numbers before the deal closes, build the entity in NetSuite, and bring it into group consolidation across multiple books and GAAPs.

This is a chance to take your accounting career to the next level in a fast-growing, acquisition-heavy software group, leading a team while growing your profile in M&A accounting, multi-GAAP consolidation, European statutory accounting and AI-augmented finance operations.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Take ownership of the GL team, align on priorities and deliver a timely, accurate month-end close across the group.
  • Run the accounting workstream on our next acquisition end to end: financial due diligence, opening balance sheet, NetSuite onboarding and first consolidation into group reporting.
  • Step in as the main point of contact for the upcoming statutory audits of our European and Canadian entities.
  • Review the current close and consolidation workflows and deliver the first automation wins using AI tools.

Your responsibilities

  • M&A due diligence & integration: Perform financial due diligence on potential deals and lead accounting through the post-merger integration (PMI) cycle, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation support and fair-value adjustments.
  • NetSuite onboarding: Design and onboard newly acquired businesses into NetSuite, setting up the chart of accounts, dimensions and reporting from day one.
  • Consolidation & multi-GAAP reporting: Own consolidation for newly acquired entities and multi-book reporting across GAAPs (group reporting alongside local statutory GAAP), including bridging between books, eliminations and intercompany reconciliations.
  • Entity accounting & tax: Own month-end close and statutory reporting for our European, Canadian and US entities, and manage local tax compliance with external tax advisors across jurisdictions.
  • Statutory audits: Lead statutory audits for our European and Canadian entities as the primary point of contact for auditors.
  • Team leadership & automation: Manage, mentor and develop the GL team, build scalable processes and controls as the group grows through acquisition, and drive automation across the GL function using AI tools.

What You bring to the table

  • Experience & education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance and 8+ years in accounting, including team leadership. CPA, ACCA or a local equivalent is strongly preferred.
  • NetSuite: Hands-on NetSuite experience is a must, including designing and onboarding new businesses or entities into NetSuite.
  • M&A accounting: First-hand experience performing financial due diligence on potential deals, supporting the PMI cycle, and consolidating newly acquired businesses.
  • Industry background: Prior experience at a SaaS, software or technology company with a multi-entity structure.
  • Ways of working: Independent, structured and analytical, with strong time management to meet financial deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment, and strong English communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience leading statutory audits across several European jurisdictions, and familiarity with transfer pricing and intercompany accounting in a multi-entity group.
  • AI Literacy & Application: You actively use AI tools to enhance personal productivity and work quality, staying curious about emerging capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply AI pragmatically in day-to-day work.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Director, Solutions Engineering

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

We’re seeking a transformational Solutions Engineering leader to lead our Mid Market and Enterprise SE teams in North America. You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.

What will I be doing?

  • Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.
  • Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.
  • Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.
  • Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.
  • Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.
  • Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.
  • Build reusable, scalable solution frameworks, and industry-specific technical assets.
  • Advocate for customer needs and insights internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
  • Represent Intercom and the SE function externally through executive meetings and strategic events.
  • Foster strong relationships with C-level stakeholders, translating AI product capabilities into tangible business impact.

What skills do I need?

  • 5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.
  • Having 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales teams, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.
  • Ideally, experience selling AI, data, or highly technical products; or at the very least, deep curiosity and utilization of AI on your day-to-day.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in environments with an ability to stay focused and thrive under pressure while working with customers to solve their most challenging issues.
  • Have a humble attitude, and a passion to help others, with a willingness to learn whatever it takes to support the team and help our customers thrive.
  • A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

The OTE salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area or NYC is $328,500-$392,375. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
Customer Success Lead

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Lead Research Advisor (Austin or Chicago)

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Research Advisor to join our growing Customer Success department. You will drive and grow important relationships by helping our customers find new ways to use our platform, ensuring they achieve maximum value from their investment. This role is a critical function that merges research expertise with a customer success motion, focusing on driving platform adoption and mitigating churn risk. You will also collaborate closely with a team of Research Advisors to design, recruit, and field research projects for our customers

You will have a chance to make a real difference for Dscout’s customers and build your career at the intersection of customer success and research. You are an incredible communicator and a genuine, creative problem-solver. You are our customer’s dedicated partner in success, helping them learn a new digital tool, execute powerful research, and maximize the return on their Dscout subscription. You collaborate closely with Account Directors to help to identify Dscout methodologies that best meet customer needs, build new use cases, identify growth opportunities, and ensure strong platform adoption across their organization. Internally, you are our customers’ champion, driving larger improvements to the platform and overall user experience.

The Lead Research Advisor position is among the most central to Dscout’s operations, so you’ll work with people from across the company on a regular basis, especially our product, engineering, and sales teams. If this sounds like you, apply today!

What you will do:

  • Own a portfolio of mid-market accounts, driving adoption, retention, and expansion across the customer lifecycle.
  • Act as a Dscout expert to train and educate customers on functionality and Dscout methodology, driving wide and deep platform adoption.
  • Proactively identify account risk (e.g., low adoption, contact turnover) and own the risk mitigation plan, partnering with the account team and escalating to leadership as needed to protect renewal outcomes.
  • Consult with customers to provide specific recommendations for their research designs on our software platform, ensuring successful outcomes and value realization.
  • Equip customers to derive insights from data using Dscout’s analysis tools.
  • Collaborate with Research Advisors to deliver and execute customer research studies.
  • Partner with our Sales & Renewal team to identify expansion opportunities and proactively mitigate risk of churn. This role carries a retention target but does not own commercial transactions.
  • Travel (up to 10%) for onsite customer visits where you will build relationships, train and share best practices, and gather feedback to bring directly back to our Product team.
  • Act as a customer advocate by sharing feedback internally to continuously improve Dscout’s product offerings.
  • Success in this role is measured by KPI targets for renewal rate, customer check-ins, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), and Renewal Manager (RM) handoffs.

What you need to have:

  • 2+ years experience in research or product design, ideally with exposure to a Customer Success, agency, or consulting model.
  • Proven ability to consult with clients/customers to drive product adoption and maximize customer lifetime value.
  • BA/BS degree in anthropology, sociology, market research, design research, HCI related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience leading complex, high-impact research engagements for in-house or for clients across all phases of qualitative research, especially scoping/planning, design, recruiting, fielding, and analysis a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written. Naturally able to strike a balance between friendly and professional in all communications.
  • Able to work both collaboratively and independently, proven experience collaborating with and mentoring team members.
  • Strong critical thinking skills; excited by the prospect of creative problem solving in the research and SaaS space alongside colleagues and customers.
  • Experience with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) for activity, and account tracking.
  • Flexible and eager to learn new things each and every day.
  • Empathetic to others’ needs and circumstances.
  • Highly organized, efficient, and detail-oriented.
  • An innate curiosity about how and why people behave the way they do, and a desire to better understand complex behavioral problems and find solutions to those problems.

Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.

About Dscout

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.

We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

It doesn't stop there. When you join the Dscout team, you will get:

  • A strong and competitive compensation package with a built-in bonus and equity program.
  • An incredible and progressive benefits package (for both you and your dependents) to support work/life balance, including flexible PTO, 15 company holidays, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, 401k match, and much more.
  • An education stipend to support your growth & development, and a remote work stipend.
