jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer, AI-Factory
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Engineer, AI-Factory

About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

The AI Factory Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between customer modular AI-ready data center requirements and Armada's Product and Engineering teams. This role requires deep technical credibility, hands-on infrastructure experience, and strong interpersonal skills to translate complex AI infrastructure and data center architectures into clear, practical solutions for customers looking to deploy sovereign AI infrastructure at speed.

This role goes beyond traditional pre-sales. The Customer Engineer acts as the technical interface between high-profile customers and Armada Engineering, ensuring customer requirements, constraints, and feedback are accurately represented and incorporated into solution design and future platform evolution.

Armada's AI Factory serves a broad and growing set of customers across enterprise, industrial, and infrastructure-heavy verticals. A meaningful and growing subset of strategic targets includes AI-focused datacenter co-location providers and Neocloud operators which represent a primary segment where Armada's high-density, liquid-cooled modular solutions are a compelling fit for capacity expansion and rapid deployment. Additionally, renewable energy operators who own or control significant land, power, and stranded energy assets are increasingly positioned to host or operate AI compute infrastructure at scale.

The ideal candidate brings an engineering and customer-first mindset, strong data center and AI-ready infrastructure expertise, particularly around AI, HPC, liquid-cooling, modular data center solutions, Nvidia reference architectures, along with the energy, curiosity, and positivity required to operate in a fast-moving, hyper-growth environment. This role is instrumental in driving adoption, trust, and long-term success for Armada's AI Factory modular solutions.

Location

Australia (Remote)

What You'll Do — Key Responsibilities

Core Technical Customer Engagement

  • Act as the primary technical interface between customers and Armada's Product and Engineering teams, translating real-world requirements into actionable technical inputs.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to Armada's AI Factory customers, including Modular Data Center (MDC)solutions, high-density and liquid-cooled designs, and GPU-based reference architectures created with partners such as NVIDIA.
  • Understand customer workloads and objectives deeply and advise on solution details including rack-level design, systems architectures, cooling and power draw advisory, and deployment strategy tradeoffs.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and workshops, tailoring content to customer constraints and operational realities.
  • Cultivate trusted-advisor relationships with customer engineering, infrastructure, IT, OT, and security stakeholders and teams
  • Engage with solution partners and supply chain, including MEP, OEM, xPU vendors, in service to end-to-end customer solutions
  • Enable field and sales teams by simplifying complex technical concepts into clear, customer-relevant narratives
  • Support RFI/P and ongoing customer-facing technical documentation required to support lighthouse customer requirements
  • Bring a high-ownership, self-starting mindset with the energy and curiosity to fill gaps, solve problems, and drive outcomes end-to-end.

AI Datacenter Co-Lo & Neocloud Engagement

  • Engage AI-focused datacenter co-location operators and Neocloud providers as a critical customer segment, positioning Armada's AI Factory as a solution for rapid capacity expansion, modular overflow deployments, and high-density liquid-cooled compute environments.
  • Develop sufficient familiarity with co-lo and Neocloud operational models — GPU cluster economics, high-density power and cooling requirements, multi-tenant compute, and deployment velocity expectations — to hold credible technical conversations and scope solutions appropriately.
  • Collaborate with Sales to identify where AI Factory's modular, rapidly deployable infrastructure is most differentiated against co-lo and Neocloud alternatives, and tailor technical positioning accordingly.

Renewable Energy & Land-and-Power Operator Engagement

  • Engage renewable energy operators, independent power producers, and upstream oil and gas companies (e.g., Chord Energy, Devon Energy, and similar) as a strategic and growing customer segment for Armada's AI Factory — helping them understand how their existing power generation capacity, land assets, and fiber infrastructure make them natural hosts for modular AI compute deployments.
  • Articulate the value proposition of Armada's MDC platform to energy sector operators: rapid deployment timelines, self-contained power and cooling architecture, scalable capacity, and the ability to monetize stranded or excess power assets through AI compute hosting.
  • Develop familiarity with the operational model of energy companies: power generation economics, land and lease structures, regulatory constraints, and the OT/IT boundary — and translate these into informed AI Factory deployment conversations.
  • Navigate both the OT and IT stakeholder landscape within energy companies, building credibility with infrastructure, operations, and executive teams alike.
  • Identify and communicate the specific deployment considerations relevant to energy sector environments: remote or off-grid locations, variable power availability, environmental and permitting requirements, and physical security constraints.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Strategy

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to support customer engagements, technical scoping, and solution design across all target verticals.
  • Stay current on industry trends related to AI infrastructure, energy sector AI adoption, data center design, liquid cooling, and modular systems — and share insights internally to shape future product strategy.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, representing Armada with customers, partners, and industry insiders
  • Bring positive energy, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to every engagement — this role values technical excellence and having fun while building something meaningful.

Forward Deployed Engineer

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

As Fin becomes mission-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with strategic customers, partnering closely with our R&D and Go-to-Market teams to design and deliver high-impact solutions. You’ll go beyond implementation - helping shape product direction, influence roadmap decisions and ensure Fin delivers real, measurable business outcomes in complex, real-world environments.

If you’re excited by ownership, creativity and solving ambiguous problems, and want to work at the frontier of applied AI while collaborating with Product, Engineering and Go-to-Market teams, this role offers a rare opportunity to combine technical excellence with real customer impact.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive adoption of Fin by helping customers unlock the power of our AI capabilities to automate and scale their support operations.
  • Embed deeply with strategic customers to understand their business challenges and technical requirements, and provide the insight needed to achieve outstanding results with Fin.
  • Work hands-on with customers’ technical teams as a trusted technical expert, coding side-by-side to drive projects through to completion.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Success and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, successful project delivery and actionable product feedback.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Forward Deployed Engineering by codifying best practices and sharing insights from customer engagements to help the team scale and grow.

What skills do I need?

  • A strong engineering background and experience building software with real-world usage. Experience building a SaaS product is a plus, but not a requirement.
  • Interest in AI and machine learning, and the ability to quickly build an understanding of novel problems, capabilities and architectures - including their trade-offs and limitations.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organisational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers.
  • Deep knowledge of at least one high-level programming language, such as JavaScript, Python or Ruby. It doesn’t need to be a language we use today - great people learn quickly and can introduce us to better ways of working.
  • The ability to prototype and ship software quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes.
  • Proficiency using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively.
  • Strong communication skills. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed.
  • Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $180,000 - $237,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Support Engineer

About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Support Engineer who thrives at the intersection of customer experience and deep technical problem-solving. You’re someone who enjoys digging into complex systems, reading code, and figuring out how things work under the hood to resolve customer issues. You take full ownership from first report to final resolution, and you’re driven to not just fix problems, but to improve the overall customer experience. You’re an empathetic communicator who can translate technical details clearly, and a proactive partner who surfaces insights to improve the product and support processes.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you’ll serve as a frontline technical expert, helping customers navigate and troubleshoot a complex product. You’ll investigate issues by working directly in the codebase and across systems, using tools like Go, TypeScript, and SQL to identify root causes and deliver solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Product to resolve issues, improve workflows, and advocate for customer needs. Your work will directly shape both the customer experience and the evolution of the product.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own and drive customer issues to resolution end-to-end

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack

  • Investigate application behavior using Go, TypeScript, and SQL

  • Analyze system architecture and code to identify root causes

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Customer Success, and Account teams

  • Support customers across the full lifecycle, including onboarding and ongoing usage

  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Ability to read and write code (Go, JavaScript/TypeScript preferred)

  • Experience troubleshooting across frontend and backend systems

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a self-service mindset

  • Clear and effective communicator across a range of audiences

  • Highly organized, able to manage multiple issues and priorities simultaneously

  • Customer-first mindset with strong empathy and ownership

  • Familiarity with databases & SQL

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with debugging production environments

  • Experience working with SQL and data-heavy systems

  • Background collaborating closely with Product and Engineering teams

  • Contributions to technical documentation, help centers, or knowledge bases

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry

ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity at Beamery

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Beamery's Data Foundry end to end. The Data Foundry is our proprietary data platform, powering existing and emerging product lines including our Talent CRM and Workforce Suite. Through this, we provide data-as-a-service to customers through channels such as MCP/API. This is an emerging commercial channel. Its core capabilities span the data models, taxonomies and integrations that underpin talent and workforce decisions across our platform.

The Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry will treat data both as infrastructure embedded within our products and as a product that customers buy in its own right. Beyond internal embedding and direct commercial sales, the platform is open — customers and partners can build on top of it through MCP and API access. You will work with product leadership to set the strategy, agree what the platform provides internally, decide what becomes customer-facing, and define how the platform opens up for customer and partner innovation.

You will work at the centre of the platform, creating a balance between two essential initiatives. On one side, you serve the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite product managers as your customers, agreeing the data contracts they build on. On the other, you partner with the data science, data engineering and integrations engineering leads to turn those needs into delivery.

What you will be doing

Ownership and strategy

  • Own the Data Foundry vision, strategy and roadmap, framing each item as a bet with a clear driver, aligned to overall strategic objectives

  • Ensure alignment of Data Foundry strategy to Beamery's AI strategy, reflecting the shift from providing AI assistants to providing AI access through MCP and API channels.

  • Decide what Data Foundry provides as internal infrastructure and what is packaged and sold as a customer-facing product.

  • Make and defend build versus buy decisions across integrations, analytics, AI and taxonomy capabilities.

Discovery and commercial impact

  • Discover and validate what external customers want from data-as-a-service, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive adoption with clear GTM and enablement plans

  • Build the case for Data Foundry as a new commercial channel, defining and proving the standalone commercial model alongside its role as platform foundation, quantify the value it unlocks for specific customers and deals, and measure success against value and usage metrics.

Partnership and delivery

  • Lead your team to deliver solutions our customers can’t imagine working without and that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Agree and maintain the data contracts with the CRM and Workforce Suite product managers, treating them as internal customers with real commitments.

  • Prioritise across data science, data engineering and integrations engineering, translating tribe needs into a clear and deliverable plan.

Communication & alignment

  • Communicate transparently and create alignment between peers and leadership on priorities, trade offs and progress

  • Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

Data governance and trust

  • Own how workforce data is governed, secured and access-controlled as it is exposed through APIs and MCP, meeting or exceeding enterprise privacy and compliance expectations.

  • Ensure the outputs of Data Foundry's models are measurable and explainable, so customers and internal teams can trust and act on the results.

What we are looking for

  • A product manager with a minimum 6 years experience in complex technical, data or AI products, a significant portion of which should be in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Strong grasp of data platforms, APIs and integrations, comfortable making architecture-adjacent decisions while collaborating with and holding priorities with engineering and data science leads.

  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data, with a clear view of governance, security and privacy.

  • An analytical thinker who uses data to find opportunities, confidently prioritise and measure success, balancing between competing tribe roadmaps and internal customers.

  • Commercially fluent, experience with 0-1 product stages, shaping early product with new go to market motions, able to connect product decisions to revenue, cost and customer ROI.

jobs.description:
Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA

Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA

The Role

Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders.

This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Lyrebird’s clinical safety management system for the UK and Ireland, ensuring DCB0129 compliance, supporting customers with DCB0160, and providing senior oversight of our Clinical Safety Officers.

  • Bring the clinical voice into the product roadmap, defining UK- and Ireland-specific workflows and leading clinical validation of new models, features and specialty templates before release.

  • Own clinical incident management and chair our clinical governance and safety committee, reporting to the leadership team and board.

  • Advise on the regulatory landscape, including MHRA medical device regulation, NHS England guidance on ambient voice technology, DTAC, and the EU AI Act for Ireland.

  • Design and deliver a clinical evidence strategy, running evaluations and real-world studies with NHS and academic partners, publishing the results, and always reporting limitations honestly.

  • Act as a trusted clinical peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and digital leaders across NHS trusts, ICBs and the HSE, and represent Lyrebird at conferences, in the media and in national policy conversations.

  • Bring clinical credibility to the commercial team by leading the clinical, safety and evidence sections of tenders, supporting pilots, and making sure every clinical claim we make stands up.

  • Build and lead a UK and Ireland clinical team, and champion equity, patient safety and inclusive design across languages, accents and patient groups.

What you’ll bring

  • Full GMC registration with a licence to practise, in good standing.

  • Significant senior clinical leadership experience in the NHS, such as Medical Director, Deputy or Associate Medical Director, or Clinical Director.

  • Substantial digital health or clinical informatics leadership, for example as a CCIO, CMIO or senior clinical lead on an EPR or digital transformation programme.

  • In-depth, practical knowledge of DCB0129 and DCB0160, clinical risk management, hazard logs and safety cases, plus a solid grasp of MHRA, DTAC, DSPT and NHS England AI guidance.

  • A track record of designing, leading or publishing clinical evaluations, audits or research.

  • Strong NHS networks and the ability to explain complex clinical, technical and regulatory issues clearly to boards, clinicians, engineers and patients.

Nice to have

  • Accredited Clinical Safety Officer training, and continuing clinical practice alongside the role.

  • Experience in a health tech, MedTech or digital health company, ideally including evaluation of AI or NLP safety and performance.

  • Knowledge of the EU AI Act, EU MDR and the Irish health system, or registration with the Medical Council of Ireland.

  • Membership or fellowship of the Faculty of Clinical Informatics, or a national profile through the Royal Colleges, NHS England or a Health Innovation Network.

  • Familiarity with clinical coding (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, OPCS-4), PRSB standards or the NICE Evidence Standards Framework.

Every minute a clinician spends on documentation is a minute taken from their patients. In this role, you’ll help decide how ambient AI is safely adopted across the NHS and in Ireland, setting the standards that protect patients while giving clinicians time back to focus on care.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Data & AI

About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for

You’re a product manager who understands how modern marketing runs on data, including first-party signals, audiences, attribution, conversion tracking, and closed-loop measurement. You reach for AI first to prototype, research, and test ideas with customers in days, not quarters. You also know where AI output can’t be trusted, so you build in evaluation and human review from the start. You think in revenue, not features. You validate willingness to pay before you build and size opportunities in dollars. You’re comfortable with undefined problems and incomplete data. You frame the customer problem before the solution, make clear trade-off calls without waiting for certainty, and explain your reasoning so others can follow it and challenge it. You also know that launch is the starting line. You aren’t done until customers are using what you shipped and seeing results.

What you’ll be doing

Freshpaint is transforming how healthcare marketers drive results. Healthcare marketers already have compliant data that could show exactly why patients land on their site and don’t book. Today, though, it takes expensive resources to turn that data into answers. Your mission is to build the data products that turn it into clear answers and confident action, without compromising privacy.

You’ll work with a dedicated engineering team on tough problems that represent big opportunities for healthcare providers, payers, and digital health companies. You’ll partner closely with Account Management, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to turn working prototypes into products customers buy, adopt, and see measurable lift from. Along the way, you’ll help shape how our product team discovers and validates ideas in an AI-first way.

Primary responsibilities

  • Improve the outcomes that matter most: build products that measurably improve results for healthcare marketers.

  • Turn insight into action: help customers act on what their data tells them, and prove the results.

  • Be first to market: launch capabilities healthcare marketers couldn’t compliantly use before, built on data customers already share with us.

  • Bring new capabilities to market: shape how new capabilities are packaged and launched, alongside PMM and Account Management.

  • Own adoption: partner with AMs and CS on activation until customers are actually using what ships and seeing results.

  • Shape AI-first product work: help define how our product team discovers and validates ideas, prototyping with customers before engineering commits.

Desired skills & experience

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including discovery and execution on products that met their performance goals

  • Fluency in data-powered marketing, including first-party data, audiences, attribution, conversion tracking, and closed-loop measurement

  • An AI-first workflow, using LLMs, coding assistants, and data agents to prototype, analyze, and research faster

  • Sound judgment about AI’s limits, with experience building evaluation and human review into AI-powered products

  • Strong commercial instincts, including sizing opportunities in dollars and validating willingness to pay before building

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to make clear, well-reasoned trade-off calls with incomplete data

  • A data-driven, outcomes-focused approach: you always find a way to measure what you build and use those metrics to decide where to spend time

  • A collaborative style that works well with engineering, design, AMs, CS, and PMM

Nice to haves

  • Experience with healthcare or health tech marketing, or familiarity with HIPAA and privacy-regulated data

  • Experience building conversion optimization, experimentation, or marketing analytics products

  • Hands-on experience with ad and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Meta

  • Experience pricing and packaging a new product or capability

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.

Account Executive

View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/ae

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, plus remote teams across several European countries. Under our choice-first work approach, you can work fully remotely from Day 1. That said, we’ve found people generally ramp faster when they spend a few days a week in the office alongside the team (esp. in the early months) and we hope you’ll want to.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £62-70k base + 100% variable (OTE £124-140k) with accelerators, at IC3 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over about 3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Max Baldry-Steen, Director of Sales

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Buyers come to Juro because we're easy to use and fast to implement, AI runs through the whole product and our product team ships fast. To keep up with that demand in 2027, we're growing our Account Executive team.

 

Your role is to drive new business growth at Juro. That means:

  1. Meet or beat your ARR target (around $800k new business a year).

  2. Build a strong pipeline, with a good share of it from leads you generate yourself.

  3. Land a clear value narrative with prospects: real pain, a business case, buy-in from several stakeholders.

  4. Keep your CRM and forecast reliable and accurate.

  5. Run a high-velocity motion that makes it easy for smaller companies to buy Juro, alongside larger $100k+ deals.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four Principles. We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

 

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You carried and hit a quota of around $800k a year at a B2B SaaS scale-up, incl. a good share of pipeline you built yourself.

  • You sold in a high-velocity motion - 5-week cycles and ACVs around $20-50k — you also closed some larger deals.

  • You multi-thread by default, and your discovery builds a business case with several stakeholders, not a feature tour.

  • You use AI every day in your sales work (research, call prep, follow-up) and have opinions about what works.

 

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • Your quota, velocity or ACV are far from ours. Quotas under $600k, 90+ day cycles, or deals well outside $20-100k usually make ramping here hard.

  • You’re waiting for marketing to fill your pipeline. Our inbound is strong, but the best reps here build their own.

  • You rely on a single champion to carry the deal.

  • You wait for the buyer to set next steps. Here, AEs ask for the deal and drive it.

  • You don't want regular feedback. We share call scorecards and pipeline data openly, and we expect you to act on them quickly.

  • Your pitch is "sales-y". We sell to legal and operations leaders, who dislike that style.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

 
 

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

 

Check if they're answered on:

  • Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/ae

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach ----- for anything.

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

London OR Cardiff OR Remote (UK) | 💰 £51,200- £64,700 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits ✨

⭐Our Complaints team

Our mission is to make money work for everyone. And while having a great app is part of that, we pride ourselves on providing world-class support. By solving customers' problems, treating them fairly and being transparent, we believe we can make banking better 💪

Our Complaints team works alongside Customer Operations to make sure customers receive the best possible service, even when things go wrong. We put empathy at the heart of how we handle complaints and use what we learn to make things better.

As our Complaints Policy Manager, you'll lead a team of technical experts and shape how we handle complaints across Monzo. You'll bring together regulatory requirements, customer needs and operational priorities to make sure our policies are clear, effective and fair. You'll play an important role in strengthening our complaints framework, influencing decisions across the business and helping us deliver better customer outcomes at scale.

🔑You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Complaints Lead Experts, creating an environment where people can grow and deliver high-quality technical advice.

  • Owning and improving our complaints policy framework, making sure processes, guidance, systems and customer communications are consistent, effective and meet regulatory expectations.

  • Providing oversight and direction on complex complaint handling issues, supporting teams to make fair, well-informed decisions across different complaint types.

  • Using insights from quality assurance, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) outcomes and escalations to identify root causes, shape our strategy and drive meaningful improvements.

  • Partnering with Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Operations leaders to develop and embed policies, frameworks and operational changes that improve customer experiences.

  • Leading our response to regulatory developments, audits and compliance reviews, making sure our controls, reporting and governance remain robust.

  • Overseeing specialist activities, including regulatory disclosures, legal escalations and engagement with third parties, to make sure we meet our obligations and deliver fair customer outcomes.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have strong knowledge of UK complaint-handling regulations, including the FCA's DISP handbook and FOS requirements, and can apply them to real customer situations.

  • You're experienced in leading, coaching and developing technical specialists, helping them build confidence and deliver great outcomes.

  • You can see the bigger picture, using complaint data, quality insights and emerging trends to shape strategy and improve how things work.

  • You're comfortable managing regulatory governance, control frameworks, audits and changes to regulatory requirements.

  • You can build strong relationships across different teams, influence senior stakeholders and turn complex regulatory information into clear, practical guidance.

  • You're confident balancing long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational challenges, making thoughtful decisions and keeping things moving.

  • You're passionate about fair customer outcomes and finding ways to make complaint handling simpler, more consistent and more empathetic.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌What’s in it for you

  • 💰£51,200 - £64,700 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits

  • ⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

  • 📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

  • 🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

  • ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

2. Recruiter Call

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. About the Role

Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. Your Area of Focus

  • Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.
  • Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.

  • Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.
